The average accuracy across all four protocols is 99.07%, surpassing the Fusion and Orthogonal Projection(FOP) baseline by 32.73%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自适应模态路由（AMR）的多模态多语种说话人识别系统，用于POLY-SIM 2026挑战赛。该系统通过动态评估每个样本的输入质量，融合音频（W2V-BERT 2.0）和人脸（IResNet-18）两种模态，在四个评测协议上达到平均99.07%的准确率，较FOP基线提升32.73%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态说话人识别系统在实际部署中面临两大关键挑战：1）模态缺失（视觉遮挡、传感器故障或隐私约束导致测试时人脸图像不可用）；2）训练与测试之间的语言不匹配。此外，背景多说话人对话、环境噪声和语音重叠进一步降低识别准确率。现有方法（如FOP）在双模态完整可用时表现良好，但在音频单模态条件下性能急剧下降（P4仅37.75%，P6仅31.70%），无法应对模态缺失和不可靠输入质量的组合挑战。
AI.method: 系统包含三个核心组件：1）音频编码器：基于W2V-BERT 2.0自监督前端，采用多帧聚合（MFA）架构整合全部25层隐藏状态，输出256维说话人嵌入，使用ArcFace损失进行三阶段渐进式训练（投影头训练→MFA微调→TTS数据增强微调）；2）人脸编码器：使用IResNet-18（带SE注意力模块），在WebFace4M上以AdaFace损失预训练，针对70个目标说话人进行单阶段微调，输出512维嵌入；3）AMR融合模块：包含两个模态适配器（将不同维度嵌入映射到共同256维空间）、一个可训练路由器（输出动态模态权重[w_a, w_f]），并采用模态感知训练策略构造四种样本类型（ORIGINAL、AUDIO_REPLACE、FACE_REPLACE、NO_FACE），使用KL散度作为权重分配的显式监督，损失函数为交叉熵损失与KL散度损失的加权和（λ=1.0）。训练采用两阶段策略：先独立训练编码器，再冻结编码器仅训练AMR模块。
AI.result: 在POLY-SIM 2026评测集上，AMR系统取得以下准确率：P3（英语多模态）99.93%、P4（英语仅音频）97.50%、P5（乌尔都语多模态）100.00%、P6（乌尔都语仅音频）98.83%，平均准确率99.07%，较FOP基线（66.34%）提升32.73%。消融实验表明：移除KL散度损失导致P5从100%降至99.75%、P3从99.93%降至99.80%；进一步移除模态感知训练使P5降至99.38%、P3降至99.74%。音频编码器三阶段训练中，仅Stage 1达93.00%，Stage 1+2达95.90%，完整三阶段达98.17%，验证了各阶段贡献。人脸单模态在P5上达到99.63%，AMR通过融合音频恢复全部6个错误实现100%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的AMR系统有效解决了多模态说话人识别中的模态缺失和输入质量不可靠问题，通过动态路由融合策略在闭集识别场景下展现出优异的鲁棒性。音频编码器虽仅用英语数据微调，却在乌尔都语音频上达到98.83%，验证了W2V-BERT 2.0预训练编码器的强跨语言迁移能力。当前局限在于仅在单一双语对（英-乌）和70个说话人上评估，未来可扩展至更多语言、更大说话人群体和附加模态。该工作表明动态路由融合范式是实际多模态说话人识别系统的实用方案。

title: Adaptive Financial Transformer with Regime-Gated Attention for Stock Return Prediction
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. PyTorch implementation and code available at: this https URL
summary: Adaptive Financial Transformer (AFT) is proposed for stock return prediction under non-stationary financial markets. The model incorporates a Market Regime Encoder, an Adaptive Gate Network, and an Adaptive Financial Context module to dynamically bias self-attention based on semantic relationships between financial indicators. Unlike conventional Transformer architectures that treat all input features uniformly, the proposed approach groups 95 engineered financial features into 11 semantic categories and adapts attention according to latent market regimes. The study also identifies and corrects sequence alignment and backtesting issues that can inflate reported trading performance, and introduces a financially-aware composite objective that jointly optimizes prediction error, directional accuracy, and non-overlapping Sharpe ratio. Extensive experiments compare the proposed architecture against classical machine learning models, recurrent neural networks, and Transformer baselines using chronological evaluation, five random seeds, ablation studies, hyperparameter optimization, explainability analysis, and multi-stock validation. Results demonstrate competitive predictive performance while reducing model complexity by 15.2% and improving parameter efficiency through feature selection, providing an interpretable Transformer architecture for financial time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应金融Transformer（AFT），通过市场状态编码器、自适应门控网络和自适应金融上下文模块，基于11个语义特征组对自注意力进行动态偏置，解决标准Transformer在金融时序预测中等向注意力、无归纳偏置和回归均值等问题。引入金融感知复合损失函数，并修正了基线文献中使夏普比率虚高√5倍的回测复合错误。在AAPL数据上经5随机种子验证，优化后的AFT以减少15.2%参数（373,143→316,319）和Top-40特征子集实现与基线相当的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 股票收益预测面临极低信噪比和非平稳市场状态两大核心挑战。标准Transformer的自注意力机制具有各向同性，将所有输入特征一视同仁，无法利用金融指标间的语义结构关系；同时缺乏时间近因性和概念关联（如成交量与波动率关系）等关键归纳偏置。此外，单纯使用MSE损失训练会导致模型向条件均值回归，预测值趋近于零，丧失方向性交易信号。现有基线文献还存在序列对齐偏差和回测中多日重叠收益的复利计算错误，使夏普比率被虚高约√5倍。
AI.method: 1) 特征工程：将95个技术指标按语义分为11组（价格、收益、波动率、趋势、动量、成交量、K线形态、统计量、滞后量、突破、日历）。2) 市场状态编码器（GRU+池化）：提取每组特征序列级统计量，融合为潜变量市场状态向量R。3) 自适应门控网络（MLP+Softmax）：基于R输出11个特征组的动态权重w。4) 自适应金融上下文：对每组特征计算余弦相似度矩阵M_g，加权求和后通过可学习缩放因子γ形成注意力偏置B_financial。5) 自适应金融注意力：将B_financial加入标准点积注意力logits中。6) 金融感知复合损失：MSE + 1-相关系数 + Sign损失（铰链式方向损失），权重由Optuna搜索。7) 序列重对齐修正：将输入窗口从X_{t-L:t-1}改为X_{t-L+1:t}以匹配h=5日前向收益目标。8) 多股票验证：在AAPL/MSFT/GOOG/AMZN/META/NVDA六只科技股上进行鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 主要定量结果：1) 优化AFT vs 基线AFT的配对t检验在MAE（p=0.38）、RMSE（p=0.21）、R²（p=0.50）、方向准确率（p=0.90）、夏普比率（p=0.95）上均无统计显著性差异，表明两者预测性能相当。2) 参数减少15.2%（373,143→316,319），但训练时间因门控计算从17.87s增至26.57s。3) 消融实验显示移除金融上下文模块使夏普从0.161降至-0.393，方向准确率下降5.2个百分点，验证了该模块贡献最大。4) 集成梯度可解释性分析表明波动率特征（Rolling Variance、ATR）和动量特征（Momentum-20）贡献最高。5) 多股票测试中AAPL/MSFT/AMZN/META成功，GOOG中性，NVDA因2023-2024生成式AI驱动的极端波动而失败（方向准确率42.21%，夏普-1.438），暴露了分布外泛化局限。
AI.conclusion: AFT架构通过市场状态门控和金融上下文偏置将领域先验注入Transformer，在保持预测性能相当的前提下实现了15.2%的参数压缩和Top-40特征子集选择效率，验证了基于语义特征分组和动态门控的正则化有效性。优化前后配对t检验无显著差异（所有p值>0.20）支持有效市场假说：日频股票收益信噪比极低，纯粹回归优化会陷入均值回归陷阱，而金融感知复合目标能恢复方向性信号。该架构为低信噪比金融时序预测提供了一个可解释的Transformer框架，但存在数据量有限（仅约1800行）、跨资产验证范围窄（仅美国大盘科技股）、对极端波动股票（NVDA）泛化失败等局限，且效率提升仅体现在参数数量而非训练速度。

title: LC-ICL: Label-Guided Contrastive In-Context Learning for Robust Information Extraction
summary: There has been increasing interest in exploring the capabilities of advanced large language models (LLMs) in the field of information extraction (IE), specifically focusing on tasks related to named entity recognition (NER) and relation extraction (RE).Although researchers are exploring the use of few-shot information extraction through in-context learning with LLMs, they tend to focus only on using correct or positive examples for demonstration, neglecting the potential value of incorporating incorrect or negative examples into the learning this http URL this paper, we present LC-ICL a novel few-shot technique that leverages both correct and incorrect sample constructions to create in-context learning demonstrations. This approach enhances the ability of LLMs to extract entities and relations by combining positive samples with negative samples annotated by error-cause labels. These labels expose more detailed error features in erroneous examples, enabling the model to understand why similar predictions fail and avoid repeating such errors during this http URL , our proposed method taps into the inherent contextual information and valuable information in hard negative samples and the nearest positive neighbors to the test and then applies the in-context learning demonstrations based on LLMs. Our experiments on various datasets indicate that LC-ICL outperforms previous few-shot in-context learning methods, delivering substantial enhancements in performance across a broad spectrum of related tasks. These improvements are noteworthy, showcasing the versatility of our approach in diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LC-ICL（Label-Guided Contrastive In-Context Learning），一种用于少样本信息抽取（命名实体识别NER和关系抽取RE）的对比式上下文学习方法。其核心创新在于同时利用正样本（正确示例）和带有错误原因标签的负样本（错误示例）构建ICL提示，通过结构化错误标注（如"实体边界错误"、"关系类型错误"等）帮助大语言模型识别并避免类似错误模式。在Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.3-70B等模型上的多个基准数据集实验中均显著优于传统仅使用正样本的ICL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型少样本信息抽取方法在进行上下文学习时，仅使用正确（正）样本作为演示示例，忽视了错误（负）样本的潜在价值。这导致模型无法学习自身的错误模式，容易重复类似错误（如幻觉问题）。论文认为负样本中蕴含的错误模式信息对于提升模型的推理鲁棒性和错误纠正能力具有重要价值，可以有效弥补传统ICL方法缺乏负反馈机制的不足。
AI.method:
1. **正样本选择**：使用KNN算法从训练集中检索与测试样本语义相似度最高的样本作为正样本示例。
2. **负样本池构建**：从训练集采样2500个样本，用推理模型M_infer生成预测，再用标注模型M_label（DeepSeek）对比预测与真实标签，为错误预测分配错误原因标签，构建负样本池。
3. **错误标签设计**：RE任务定义6类错误（缺失关系、实体/关系类型错误、实体边界错误、未定义关系、实体正确但关系错误、实体顺序颠倒），NER任务定义5类错误（实体边界错误、实体类型错误、实体缺失、未定义实体类型、虚假实体）。
4. **检索策略**：对测试样本使用KNN算法从负样本池中检索最相似的负样本，与正样本一起组成ICL演示输入。
5. **推理流程**：将正样本𝒫、负样本𝒩、指令ℐ和测试样本X_t输入推理模型生成最终结果。
AI.result:
在5个RE数据集（CoNLL04、NYT10、NYT11、SciERC、ADE）和3个NER数据集（ACE04、ACE05、NCBI）上使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct进行测试。主要结果包括：
- **RE任务**：LC-ICL在所有数据集上一致优于PE方法。Llama-3.1-8B上NYT10从15.73%提升至38.69%（+146%），NYT11从8.28%提升至21.52%（+159.8%）；Llama-3.3-70B上NYT10从27.77%提升至42.04%，CoNLL04达到50.71% F1。
- **NER任务**：LC-ICL在大多数数据集上优于PE方法。Llama-3.3-70B上ACE04从37.18%提升至44.53%，NCBI从38.20%提升至56.36%。
- **消融实验**：结构化标签方法优于自然语言解释方法；简洁标签优于带定义的标签（Label优于Label_Def）；随机检索场景下仍保持显著优势，证明方法鲁棒性强。
AI.conclusion: LC-ICL通过引入带有错误原因标签的负样本，有效解决了传统ICL方法在少样本信息抽取中仅依赖正样本而缺乏负反馈机制的问题。实验证明该方法在NER和RE任务上均取得显著提升，且在不同模型规模（8B和70B）上均有效，展示了良好的通用性和鲁棒性。研究表明，合理设计的结构化错误标注比冗长的自然语言解释更能有效引导模型识别和避免错误模式。论文的局限在于：仅在英文数据集上验证，尚未探索其他IE任务和语言的适用性。

title: Interpretable Inverse Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks with Large Language Model Agents
summary: Inverse design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) requires searching a combinatorially vast space where property labels are expensive and most machine-learning models reveal little about why a structure succeeds. We introduce LLM4MOF, a closed-loop framework in which language-model agents reason about chemistry, build candidate MOFs, and test them in simulation, refining hypotheses over ten autonomous iterations. One agent proposes interpretable design hypotheses over metal nodes, linkers, pore geometry, and functional chemistry, and a second translates them into constraints that select candidate MOFs, each made of a metal node, organic linker, and matching topology. Each hypothesis is tested through four diagnostic beams that apply different subsets of its constraints, so comparing them shows whether geometry, chemistry, or metal choice drives performance. Even when blind to the global property landscape of databases, LLM4MOF concentrates its search on top-performing structures across six adsorption, separation, and electronic-structure tasks within 400 property evaluations. The same loop also generates new MOFs de novo and validates them in live simulation, where it adapts the geometry to each requested condition, outperforming random search and a genetic algorithm at roughly $1 per campaign. LLM4MOF shows that language-model agents can run interpretable, simulation-grounded inverse design without training a model per objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLM4MOF 框架，利用大语言模型智能体实现金属-有机框架(MOF)的可解释逆向设计。该框架通过化学推理、候选构建和仿真测试的闭环循环，在400次属性评估内即可在六类吸附/分离/电子结构任务中找到高性能MOF，并支持全新MOF的从头生成与实时仿真验证。
AI.motivation: MOF逆向设计面临组合爆炸的化学空间与昂贵的属性评估成本；现有机器学习方法多作为黑盒预测器，缺乏对"为何某种结构有效"的可解释性洞察，且需针对每个目标重新训练模型，效率低、可迁移性差。
AI.method: 采用双智能体闭环架构：(1) 假设提出智能体在金属节点、有机连接子、孔几何与功能化学四个维度上生成可解释的设计假设；(2) 约束翻译智能体将其转化为筛选约束，挑选由金属节点+连接子+匹配拓扑构成的候选MOF。每个假设通过四束诊断测试(应用约束的不同子集)来区分几何、化学或金属选择对性能的贡献。系统共进行十轮自主迭代，并集成从头生成与实时仿真验证。
AI.result: 在六项吸附、分离与电子结构任务中，LLM4MOF 在仅400次属性评估内即可将搜索集中于数据库中的顶级结构，且在缺乏全局属性景观先验的条件下依然有效。在全新MOF从头生成与实时仿真验证中，框架能根据目标条件自适应调整几何结构，性能优于随机搜索与遗传算法，单次设计活动成本约1美元。
AI.conclusion: LLM4MOF 证明了大语言模型智能体能够在无需针对每个目标训练专用模型的情况下，执行可解释、仿真驱动的MOF逆向设计。其闭环假设-测试-精化机制兼具可解释性与高效性，为AI驱动的材料发现提供了新范式。

title: CRAFT: Counterfactual Credit Assignment from Free Sibling Rollouts for Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Self-distilled agentic reinforcement learning augments trajectory-level reward with a token-level distillation loss, using as its teacher the same policy conditioned on privileged context. The prevailing recipe gates this loss by a single scalar, the teacher-student log-probability gap. This signal is doubly limited: it is retrospective, scoring only the realised rollout and never the counterfactual ones, and it is sign-blind, never signalling when a teacher-preferred action would have harmed the trajectory. We introduce CRAFT, a three-pillar credit-assignment scheme that addresses both limitations. Pillar 1, Counterfactual Token Importance, reuses the G-1 sibling rollouts that GRPO already samples and importance-weights them by the log-probability gap to form a self-normalised estimate of the group-level counterfactual change in advantage from up-weighting teacher-preferred actions at each step; this yields a signed per-token credit at near-zero extra compute. Pillar 2 is an asymmetric controller that raises the distillation weight as it lowers the reference-KL weight along an exponential moving average of gate activity, and conversely. Pillar 3 polarises the KL penalty token by token, switching between a mode-seeking and a mode-covering update according to the sign of the credit. Each pillar has an independent switch that, when disabled, renders the loss and gradient byte-identical to the baseline in IEEE-754 arithmetic, so any measured gain is attributable to algorithmic change rather than implementation drift. We prove the estimator's consistency and a variance bound, give structural and bit-exact reproducibility guarantees, and evaluate CRAFT across three agentic environments, four model scales, and five end-to-end methods, plus two tabulated prior-work baselines. Among these is Adaptive-CRINGE, a comparator sharing Pillar 2 with CRAFT, isolating the counterfactual contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRAFT，一种三支柱的信用分配方案，用于自蒸馏智能体强化学习。它通过重用GRPO已经采样的G-1个兄弟轨迹，并使用对数概率差进行重要性加权，构建了一个自归一化的反事实token重要性（CTI）估计器；再配合相位感知自适应控制器和方向极化的KL惩罚，将现有的"单门控回顾式"信号升级为"有符号、前瞻式"的逐token信用。CRAFT在四个模型规模、三个智能体环境、五个端到端方法的对比中均取得最优，并通过Adaptive-CRINGE对比基线隔离出反事实信号的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏智能体RL（SDAR等）使用教师-学生log概率差Δ_t作为单一标量门控信号，但该信号存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 回顾式（retrospective）——只对已实现的轨迹打分，从不评估反事实；(2) 符号盲（sign-blind）——当教师偏好的动作实际上会损害轨迹时，该信号也不会提示。这导致per-token信用信号丢失了关键的前瞻信息和方向信息，限制了教师信号的利用效率。
AI.method: CRAFT由三个支柱组成：(1) **Pillar 1 (CTI)**：基于GRPO已采样的G-1个兄弟轨迹，以exp(Δ_t)为重要性权重，做自归一化重要性采样，估计"在第t步若从教师采样会对组级advantage产生何种反事实变化"，输出有符号信用c_t∈(-1,1)；(2) **Pillar 2 (相位感知控制器)**：基于门活跃度ρ_gate的EMA，以反方向联动调节蒸馏权重λ(t)与参考KL权重μ(t)——蒸馏活跃时加大λ降低μ，饱和时则相反；(3) **Pillar 3 (方向极化KL)**：按sign(c_t)逐token切换反向KL（c_t>0，模式寻求）、正向KL（c_t<0，模式覆盖）或标准KL（中性区）。每柱都有独立主开关，关闭时与基线在IEEE-754下逐字节相同（P7），保证归因清晰。理论上证明了CTI估计量的一致性（Prop. 1）和O(1/G)方差界（Prop. 2），并给出了控制器不动点、极化KL结构一致性、替代目标有效性等结构性质。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、Search-QA、WebShop三个智能体环境，Qwen3-1.7B/2.5-3B/2.5-7B/3-8B四个模型规模上，CRAFT-Full在12个(环境,模型)单元格中全部最优。核心对比CRAFT-Full vs Adaptive-CRINGE（共享Pillar 2，隔离P1+P3贡献）在所有单元格上均为正（Qwen3-1.7B上+2.6 ALFWorld、+2.3 WebShop）。每柱消融显示Pillar 1贡献主体增益（+1.9/+2.0/+1.5），Pillar 2/3为小幅补全；反事实消融(A6, G_min=999)将增益坍缩到SDAR基线，KL方向反转消融(A7)则跌破基线，作为P5的证伪测试。OOD和随机检索压力测试显示CRAFT-Full泛化间隙最小（6.2 vs 9.5），随机检索下降温和（78.5 vs 72.0）。模型规模越大，增益绝对值缩小（+5.5@1.7B → ~1.6-2.1@7B-8B），与ρ_gate随模型增大而减小的预测一致。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT将自蒸馏智能体RL从单门控回顾式方案推进到三支柱反事实方案：(i) GRPO已有的G-1兄弟轨迹是"免费的"反事实样本池，无需额外采样；(ii) 正确的per-token信用应是"若在第t步遵循教师采样所导致的序列advantage反事实变化"；(iii) 由此产生的有符号信用可自然分解为估计量（P1）、幅度控制器（P2）、符号路由器（P3）。两个方法论要素具有超越本方法的通用价值：位精确可复现性（P7）作为可证伪的基底，以及Adaptive-CRINGE对比基线——共享控制器以隔离反事实信号。局限在于需要组采样（G≥2）、引入9个新超参数、Pillar 3独立增益小、文本域内评测；下一步可显式估计组内可交换性间隙，将组级信用校准回逐轨迹反事实。

title: To Reason or to Fabricate: Reasoning Without Shortcuts via Hint-Anchored Pairwise Aggregation
summary: While reinforcement learning (RL) significantly enhances LLM reasoning, its efficacy is severely undermined by Pre-RL data overlap, where RL datasets overlap with pretraining or SFT corpora, causing models to exploit shortcuts by memorizing correct answers and fabricating post-hoc reasoning. To address this, we introduce HIPPO, a novel RL framework that integrates hint-injected aggregation with a tailored pairwise reward model. By utilizing hint injection to deliberately trigger overlap-induced behaviors, the resulting traces naturally serve as explicit anchors for pairwise comparison. This provides highly discriminable preference signals, enabling a lightweight judge model to reliably distinguish genuine reasoning deduction from shortcut-driven rationalization, while the pairwise formulation ensures stable and robust optimization compared to standard PRMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIPPO yields substantial improvements over standard baselines and generalizes effectively to out-of-distribution general tasks, showing it extracts authentic, transferable reasoning skills rather than superficial shortcut patterns.

AI.tldr: HIPPO是一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过"提示注入聚合"（hint-injected aggregation）与"配对奖励模型"（pairwise reward model）缓解大语言模型RL训练中因Pre-RL数据重叠导致的"记忆捷径"问题，使模型学习真实推理而非事后合理化。
AI.motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）虽显著提升LLM推理能力，但常用RL数据集与预训练/SFT语料存在大量重叠（Pre-RL Data Overlap），导致模型通过记忆正确答案、走捷径获取最大奖励，并事后编造合理化推理。这削弱了探索深度，损害推理可靠性，造成能力虚高。现有工作多关注训练-评估阶段的数据泄露检测，对训练阶段间重叠的负面影响研究不足，且严格隔离数据不切实际。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"受污染的捷径策略"π_C（依靠记忆答案绕过演绎），目标是最小化π_θ与π_C的KL散度。2) 因KL散度无界且方差随轨迹长度线性增长，利用Pinsker不等式与TV距离的变分表示，理论推导出有界替代目标：最大化标准采样与提示注入采样之间的配对比较期望。3) 实践上通过在prompt中前置注入真实答案来实例化π_C（"提示注入"），使模型倾向于生成事后合理化推理。4) 使用Bradley-Terry配对比较器J替代点式奖励模型，将配对胜率二值化后与答案正确性、格式奖励结合。5) 通过对称化（双向平均）消除LLM评判器位置偏差。6) 提供Logit Lens与基于Kolmogorov复杂度代理的因果方向分析以验证捷径机制。
AI.result: 在数学（DeepScaleR）和医学（MedQA）推理任务上，使用Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-4B骨干，HIPPO在域内及域外基准（MATH-500、TheoremQA、MMLU-Pro、GPQA等）均一致优于SFT-only、standard RL、Pointwise PRM RL、Pref-GRPO、SP3F等基线。HIPPO平均准确率55.5（数学）/55.4（医学），较标准RL分别+1.5和+2.4。提示注入的失败模式比自然Pre-RL重叠的错误耦合更紧密，提供了更易区分的偏好信号；小模型（如Qwen3-4B）作评判器时配对评估的AUROC达78.4、Precision@1达84.7，远优于点式评估。PNT（非传递比例）随模型容量提升而持续降低。Logit Lens显示RL后浅层隐藏状态已确定最终答案；因果复杂度差在重叠数据上从+14.84骤降至+0.93，表明推理→答案的因果方向被破坏。案例分析显示HIPPO输出忠实演绎，标准RL则编造伪科学机制。
AI.conclusion: HIPPO通过理论上有界且方差可控的配对奖励替代目标，有效抑制了Pre-RL数据重叠引发的记忆捷径行为，提取出真实、可迁移的推理能力。提示注入作为行为锚显著提升了配对评判的可区分度、稳定性与可扩展性，使小模型可作为可靠评判器。该工作从"检测"转向"缓解"，为受污染RL数据下的有效训练提供了新范式。局限：仅注入正确答案、提示注入与标准采样独立生成（未共享前缀）、引入额外计算开销。

title: Reported Confidence in LLMs Tracks Commitment More Than Correctness
summary: Confidence is an estimate of the probability that a chosen answer is correct. Verbal confidence reports are widely used as uncertainty measures in large language models, but whether they are best understood as estimates of correctness is unclear. We test this with a two-stage abstention paradigm from the neuroscience of perceptual decision making: a model first answers and reports its confidence, then decides whether to commit it to a user or abstain. Across four non-reasoning models, prompt framings, and confidence formats, verbal confidence predicted the commit/abstain decision substantially better than whether the answer was correct. Calibrated token log-probabilities showed the opposite profile, with abstention-prediction coupled to correctness discrimination, the signature of an answer-evidence signal. After removing the variance verbal confidence shared with log-probabilities, the residual stayed aligned with commitment while its link to correctness fell to near chance. The dissociation generalised to four reasoning models across four benchmarks of varying difficulty, from hard multiple-choice to frontier-level freeform questions. Mechanistic analyses in Gemma 3 and 4 were convergent: a post-answer state known to causally support verbal-confidence generation already encoded the future abstention decision before the abstention prompt, organised mainly by that decision rather than by correctness, the two lying in approximately orthogonal directions in activation space. Steering along a verbal-confidence-specific direction causally shifted abstention. Verbal and log-probability confidence are thus not interchangeable: log-probabilities track answer evidence and correctness, whereas verbal confidence is better understood as a behaviour-facing readout of an internal commit-readiness state, challenging the practice of treating verbal reports as proxies for reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"语言模型口头置信度是对答案正确性的估计"这一常见假设，提出口头置信度（VC）本质上更接近一种"承诺就绪状态"的信号，而非正确性估计。通过两阶段弃答范式（先回答并报告置信度，再决定是否提交），研究发现VC显著更好地预测后续的提交/弃答决策，而非答案正确性；而校准的log-prob置信度（Cal-LP）则与正确性紧密耦合。机制分析（Gemma 3/4）揭示答案生成后的内部状态已编码未来弃答决策，方向与正确性表征近似正交，且沿VC特定方向的因果干预可改变弃答行为。
AI.motivation: 口头置信度是LLM中广泛使用的不确定性度量，尤其在推理模型中几乎是唯一可用信号。用户和下游系统常将其视为答案正确性的代理。但作者质疑：VC究竟在度量什么？它是P(correct)的估计，还是模型"是否愿意为该答案背书"的内部承诺状态的读出？这对如何理解和使用LLM置信度信号有根本影响。
AI.method: 采用两阶段弃答范式（源自神经科学感知决策研究）：Phase 1模型生成答案并报告口头置信度（类别式Class-VC和数值式Num-VC）以及Cal-LP（温度缩放的选项log-prob）；Phase 2在呈现Phase 1答案后让模型做二元的提交/弃答决策。关键指标为"决策-真值间隙"Δ_DT = AUROC(弃答) − AUROC(正确性)。使用互反残差化（VC on Cal-LP, Cal-LP on VC）区分信号特定成分。在Gemma 3/4上做激活层线性探针、2×2 ANOVA偏η²分析、双峰性检验以及激活引导（steering）因果干预。涵盖4个非推理模型×2数据集、4个推理模型×4数据集（含HLE自由作答）。
AI.result: 1) 行为层面：46个VC单元平均决策-真值间隙为+0.16（t=11.6, p<0.001）；Cal-LP则近零（p=0.36）。VC间隙在15/16推理单元为正，14/16超过+0.05阈值；Cal-LP 7/7推理配对单元均被VC超过。2) 残差化：VC残差保留弃答预测力（中位AUROC=0.64），正确性预测崩溃至接近随机（中位0.49，多个单元<0.5），排除VC仅为有噪正确性读出；反向残差中Cal-LP仍强正确性对齐。3) 机制层：Gemma 4 PA位置决策探针AUROC达0.94，正确性探针仅0.66；两方向余弦相似度−0.01（近似正交）；决策投影呈强双峰（Hartigan D=0.13, p<10⁻⁶），模式权重匹配行为弃答比例。4) 因果：沿VC_orth方向低置信度引导显著提升弃答率。5) 鲁棒性：在中性弃答提示、包含正确性/难度的更严格残差化下结论仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 口头置信度与log-prob置信度是不可互换的不确定性度量：Cal-LP本质上是答案证据信号，其行为相关性来自正确性追踪；VC则是内部"承诺就绪"状态的行为面向读出，对正确性的追踪远弱于对提交/弃答决策的追踪。这一发现挑战了将VC报告视为可靠性代理的通行做法，对下游系统的置信度解释、用户信任校准、以及训练目标设计（需将置信度更紧地锚定于正确性同时保留适应性行为）有直接启示，也呼应了人类元认知研究中"置信度作为控制信号"而非纯回顾性正确性报告的二阶理论。

title: The Verbose Context Problem in Medical Records
summary: The verbose context problem occurs when structured concepts have token-inefficient textual representations. This bottleneck is acute in population health: cohort-level analysis of longitudinal patient records requires reasoning over thousands of medically-coded events, often exceeding 400K tokens in total. We present PopMedQA, a benchmark isolating this problem through computational tasks on groups of longitudinal patient records. We construct the benchmark using neopatient, a new library for language-controlled generation of artificial patient records. Through extensive ablations -- including prompting strategies, prompt compression, and agentic decomposition -- we find that domain-independent methods fail to alleviate the verbose context problem. There remains significant opportunity to exploit domain-specific structure in language model inputs for population-scale reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 PopMedQA 基准，用于评估语言模型在纵向患者记录群体级分析中的"冗余上下文问题"，并发现领域无关的方法（如提示压缩、智能体分解）均无法有效解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 在群体健康研究中，对纵向患者记录进行队列级分析需要处理数千个医学编码事件，上下文常超过 40 万 tokens，构成"冗余上下文"瓶颈。现有方法能否缓解该问题尚不清楚，需要系统性评估。
AI.method: 1）提出 PopMedQA 基准，将冗余上下文问题抽象为针对纵向患者记录群的计算任务；2）开发 neopatient 库，用于语言受控的人工患者记录生成；3）通过广泛的消融实验，对比提示策略、提示压缩、智能体分解等方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，领域无关的方法（包括提示工程、提示压缩、智能体分解）均未能有效缓解冗余上下文问题，现有 LLM 在群体规模推理上仍存在显著性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 亟需开发能利用语言模型输入中领域特定结构的新方法，以实现群体规模的医学推理；PopMedQA 与 neopatient 为该方向提供了标准化评估与数据生成基础。

title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
summary: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RESOURCE2SKILL organizes these skills as a hierarchical multimodal Skill Wiki, where each entry combines structured text, code, visual examples, metadata, and provenance. This design preserves complementary signals from different resources: videos capture temporal operations and visual effects, code captures executable tool patterns, and articles or artifacts provide conceptual and stylistic grounding. At inference time, agents retrieve and compose relevant skills from the wiki; when coverage is insufficient, the same construction operator can acquire new skills online. Across seven practical authoring domains, RESOURCE2SKILL improves average overall score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents and outperforms strong harness baselines in 26 of 28 main-aggregate model-domain cells. Ablations confirm the value of multimodal skill format, hierarchical organization, source diversity, selection strategy, and online acquisition.

AI.tldr: RESOURCE2SKILL提出了一种将多模态人类资源（教程视频、代码仓库、文章、参考制品）蒸馏为软件代理可执行技能的框架，通过构建层次化的多模态技能Wiki（Skill Wiki），使LLM代理在七个创作类软件领域中平均提升11.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有技能库主要依赖人工编写、文本中心或从代理自身轨迹中提取，忽视了教程视频等多模态人类资源中蕴含的程序性知识。视频能捕获时序操作和视觉变化，文本难以表达，但直接将原始视频放入代理记忆既昂贵又会丢失关键信息，因此需要一种有效蒸馏和组织的机制。
AI.method: 框架包含四个阶段：(1) 构造算子 (f_θ, A_D) 从教程视频、代码、文章、参考制品四类资源中蒸馏出候选技能；(2) 层次化多模态技能Wiki组织，每个条目包含结构化文本、可执行代码、视觉示例、元数据和溯源信息；(3) MetaBrowse两阶段检索（BM25按分类路径筛选+LM选择）；(4) 通过MCP执行，必要时在线调用同一算子补充新技能。
AI.result: 在Web、Excel、Reaper、PPT、Blender、CAD、UE5七个创作领域、四种代理后端上，w Skills在全部28个模型-领域主聚合单元中均优于w/o Skills（平均56.8% vs 45.0%，+11.9pp），并在26/28个单元中优于ClaudeCode-H和Codex-H两个强基线。消融实验验证了多模态格式、层次组织、源多样性（视频不可替代）、选择策略和在线获取（对T_novel提升+21.6pp）的价值。人类A/B研究（200对配对评分）也证实83.3%的非平局对中w Skills更优。
AI.conclusion: RESOURCE2SKILL证明了从人类创建的多模态资源中蒸馏技能能为软件代理提供可复用的程序性知识，在多样化创作领域中持续优于无技能代理和强代理框架。视频是不可替代的源类型，层次化wiki+多模态条目+在线补全是关键设计选择，使技能库成为可维护、可扩展的程序性记忆而非固定的提示集合。

title: Coverage-Driven KV Cache Eviction for Efficient and Improved Inference of LLM
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks like question answering and summarization, thanks to their ability to handle long-context inputs. However, deploying LLMs is costly, not only due to the high computational demands of quadratic complexity of self-attention and auto-regressive generation, but also because of the significant memory overhead required for storing the key-value (KV) cache during inference. To reduce the memory cost, existing KV-cache eviction strategies leverage the sparsity in attention to selectively store a subset of tokens. While reducing the memory footprint, such approaches show a considerable drop in performance, especially in tasks that require long-context reasoning. We identify that the drop in performance is linked to a reduction in the coverage of unique tokens. Additionally, we theoretically show that reduced coverage limits the mutual information between inputs and outputs, thereby impairing predictive accuracy. To this end, we introduce K-VEC, a novel coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy that prioritizes token coverage while evicting tokens in the cache. K-VEC introduces a cross-head and a cross-layer coverage module to enhance token retention across attention heads and model layers, mitigating performance degradation caused by low coverage. Evaluated on 16 LongBench subsets, K-VEC exhibit up to 10.35 points improvement over the existing methods under the same eviction rate and memory constraint. Comprehensive evaluations validate the effectiveness of our approach and demonstrate its potential for efficient LLM deployment in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 K-VEC（KV Cache Eviction with Coverage），一种面向 LLM 长上下文推理的覆盖度感知 KV 缓存逐出策略。通过引入跨注意力头（cross-head）和跨层（cross-layer）覆盖度模块，在驱逐 token 时优先考虑 token 覆盖度多样性，从而在相同内存约束下显著提升长上下文任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 KV 缓存逐出方法（如 H2O、SnapKV、PyramidKV、AdaKV）在较高驱逐率下性能显著下降，尤其在长上下文推理任务中。作者发现性能下降的根源在于 token 覆盖度（unique token coverage）的降低——现有方法在跨头和跨层独立计算驱逐分数，导致相似 token 被反复保留或驱逐，造成 token 覆盖度大幅下降。理论上，作者利用信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）框架证明覆盖度下降会限制输入与输出之间的互信息，从而损害预测准确性。
AI.method:
1. **理论分析（Coverage Hypothesis）**：利用数据处理不等式（DPI）和信息瓶颈理论，推导覆盖度 C 与互信息 I(X;Y) 的关系，证明 C 下降会不可逆地降低预测性能。
2. **跨头覆盖度模块（Cross-Head Coverage）**：通过标准差识别"低聚焦"的头（评分近似均匀的头），对这些头扩大观察窗口 O'（从 16 扩展到 32），以鼓励选择更多样化的 token。
3. **跨层覆盖度模块（Cross-Layer Coverage）**：跟踪每个 token 被前序层选中的次数（coverage score），定义 focus score = importance × (1 - coverage)，将全局重要性与新颖性结合，用于调整逐出优先级。
4. **重要 token 保护机制**：保留每头原始评分中 top-K（β·B，K=25%）的 token，确保关键信息不被覆盖度优化所牺牲。
AI.result:
在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上对 LongBench 的 16 个子集进行全面评估：
- 在 128 token 极低预算下，K-VEC 平均提升 1.61 分，在 Qasper 等上下文敏感任务上最高提升 **10.35 分**。
- 在 256/512/1024 token 预算下也均优于 SnapKV、PyramidKV、AdaKV、StreamingLLM、HeadKV、GemFilter 等基线。
- 覆盖度分析：K-VEC 覆盖度达 94.5%，而 SnapKV 仅 86.6%；在 0.9 高驱逐率下 K-VEC 仅下降 8.6%，远优于现有方法。
- Needle-in-a-Haystack 测试中达到 98.2 分，与 HeadKV 持平，优于 SnapKV 的 87.4 分。
- 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上同样验证了泛化性。
- 消融实验验证了两个模块的互补性：去掉任一模块均导致显著性能下降。
AI.conclusion: K-VEC 通过覆盖度感知的逐出策略有效解决了 LLM 长上下文推理中 KV 缓存的内存瓶颈问题。其跨头和跨层覆盖度模块在保持计算效率（仅预填充阶段略慢，解码速度相当）的同时，显著提升了低缓存预算下的性能，为资源受限场景下的 LLM 部署提供了实用方案。局限性在于预填充阶段计算开销略有增加，且不追求完全覆盖度（因部分 token 本身缺乏信息量）。未来工作可探索与其他优化技术的结合以进一步提升 LLM 效率。

title: The Joint Effect of Quantization and Sampling Temperature on LLM Safety Alignment: A Factorial Analysis
summary: Modern LLM deployments routinely compress models and raise sampling temperature to reduce cost, latency, or repetition, yet safety evaluations usually treat these choices as fixed implementation details. This leaves a practical uncertainty: does a model that is safe at FP16 and greedy decoding remain safe after it is quantized and sampled stochastically, or do the two deployment knobs amplify one another? We study this question with a factorial evaluation of 9 instruction-tuned models from six families, 3 precisions (FP16, GPTQ INT8, AWQ INT4), and 6 temperatures ($T{=}0$ to $1.0$), yielding 161 configurations and $\approx$322k responses judged by a six-model safety ensemble. Contrary to the concern that low-bit deployment broadly erodes alignment, standard non-adversarial quantization is usually safety-neutral: INT4 keeps or lowers attack success for 7 of 9 models, with clear degradation concentrated in the weakest baseline model, SmolLM3-3B ($18.5\%{\to}36.0\%$). The larger risk comes from sampling: higher temperature sharply increases decision instability for vulnerable models, with DFR reaching 53.0\% at $T{=}1.0$, even when average ASR changes modestly. Finally, the interaction is not a ``double penalty'': our Compound Degradation Index remains largely sub-additive ($-0.195$ to $+0.045$), indicating that quantization and temperature do not systematically compound. These results suggest a deployment rule of thumb: standard INT4/INT8 quantization can be reasonable for strongly aligned models, but safety claims at elevated temperature should report multi-sample stability, not only average attack success.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模析因实验（161种配置、9个模型、3种精度、6种温度，约32.2万条响应）系统研究了量化与采样温度对LLM安全对齐的联合影响。核心结论：标准INT4/INT8量化通常对安全影响中性甚至有益；采样温度升高带来的风险主要表现为决策不稳定性（DFR），且集中在弱对齐模型上；两者交互呈亚可加性（CDI在-0.195到+0.045之间），不存在"双重惩罚"效应。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估通常在FP16+贪心解码的固定配置下进行，但实际部署中模型常被量化为INT8/INT4并使用非零温度采样。量化与温度对安全对齐的独立影响已有零星研究，但两者联合作用是否存在叠加放大效应尚未明确，亟需面向部署实践的系统评估。
AI.method: 采用2×2×…析因设计：9个指令调优模型（覆盖Llama-3、Qwen3、Mistral、OLMo-2、Granite、SmolLM3六大族系，2B-8B参数量）× 3种精度（FP16、GPTQ INT8、AWQ INT4，使用llmcompressor+Pile验证集标准校准）× 6种温度（T=0/0.3/0.5/0.7/0.95/1.0），每配置每提示采5个样本。提示集为AdvBench 200条有害提示+XSTest 200条良性提示。评估采用6模型安全评判集成（多数投票）。核心指标包括：ASR（攻击成功率）、RR（拒绝率）、ORR（过度拒绝率）、SSI（安全稳定性指数）、DFR（决策翻转率），并提出复合退化指数CDI（量化×温度交互项）和温度等价映射。推理在2×RTX 6000 Pro 96GB上使用vLLM完成。
AI.result: (1) 量化效应：AWQ INT4在9个模型中有7个保持或降低ASR；4个强对齐模型（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-4B/8B、OLMo-2-7B）在所有精度下ASR均为0%。例外是弱对齐的SmolLM3-3B，INT4使ASR从18.5%升至36.0%。(2) 温度效应：温度对ASR影响呈非单调性，部分模型在T≈0.3-0.5时最保守；但高温显著增加决策不稳定性——FP16/T=1.0时Mistral-7B的DFR达53.0%，SmolLM3-3B达46.5%，而其余7个模型DFR≤3.5%。(3) 交互效应：CDI在-0.195至+0.045之间，多数值集中在±0.03内，呈亚可加性而非叠加惩罚；最强的亚可加效应出现在SmolLM3-3B INT4/T=0.95（CDI=-0.195）。(4) 过度拒绝率在所有161种配置中均低于8%。(5) 温度等价映射显示强对齐模型的量化安全行为在所有测试温度下均接近FP16。(6) 6个评判模型间配置级ASR一致率为68.3%-90.1%，ShieldGemma-9B与主评判最接近（90.1%，Δ=+0.007）。
AI.conclusion: 标准后训练量化（GPTQ INT8、AWQ INT4）配合标准校准数据不会系统性侵蚀安全对齐，效应高度依赖基线对齐强度——强对齐模型几乎不受影响，弱对齐模型（如SmolLM3-3B）才出现显著退化。采样温度才是主要的稳定性风险因子，但其危害集中于少数弱对齐模型。量化与温度之间不存在"双重惩罚"，交互以亚可加为主。实践建议：(1) INT4/INT8量化对强对齐模型可安全使用；(2) 温度>0时的安全评估应报告多样本稳定性指标（SSI/DFR）而非仅平均ASR；(3) 应对基线对齐较弱的模型单独验证量化安全性。CDI与温度等价映射为部署感知的安全评估提供了新工具。

title: Bilevel Optimization for Neural Architecture Search
summary: Bilevel optimization has become an influential and widely adopted framework for addressing hierarchical optimization problems in machine learning, providing an effective approach to modeling the interaction between two levels of optimization, with applications such as hyperparameter tuning, meta-learning, adversarial training, and data poisoning. Neural Architecture Search (NAS), a subfield of hyperparameter optimization, is a prime example of a bilevel optimization problem, with architecture parameters optimized at the outer-level and network weights optimized at the inner level. This paper presents a structured overview of NAS through the lens of bilevel optimization. We categorize existing NAS approaches into two main classes: sampling-based methods, which search optimal architectures using different architecture samplers, and bilevel theory-based methods, which solve the architecture search problem using bilevel optimization principles. We further highlight our current research direction, wherein the bilevel NAS formulation is addressed through an auxiliary mathematical programming framework. This framework enables the systematic integration of second-order information from the model's training loss function and ensures the optimality of the model parameters while modifying architecture parameters. By simultaneously updating the architecture and model parameters along their respective optimal descent directions derived from the auxiliary mathematical program, these methods achieve more principled and theoretically consistent results. The same auxiliary program can also be used for simultaneous hyperparameter and model fine-tuning. A comparative analysis shows that bilevel theory-based approaches generally outperform sampling-based methods, both in accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了双层优化（Bilevel Optimization）在神经架构搜索（NAS）中的应用，将现有NAS方法划分为采样驱动类与双层理论驱动类两大体系，并重点提出了一种基于辅助数学规划的统一框架（AP-NAS），通过同时利用训练损失的二阶Hessian信息与KKT条件，确保在更新架构参数时始终维持下层模型参数的最优性，从而获得理论上更严谨且经验上更优的搜索结果。
AI.motivation: 神经架构搜索（NAS）本质上是一个层次化的优化问题：外层优化架构参数，内层优化网络权重，属于双层优化问题（BOP）的典型代表。然而传统的NAS方法（尤其是基于强化学习或进化计算的采样方法）计算开销巨大且缺乏理论一致性；而现有可微NAS方法（如DARTS）虽高效，但基于一阶梯度的更新会破坏下层模型参数的最优性，缺乏理论保证。因此，亟需一种既能系统性融入训练损失二阶曲率信息、又能保持下层最优性的双层NAS理论框架。
AI.method: 本文首先形式化定义了双层优化问题（乐观/悲观/高点松弛三种公式），并梳理了KKT重构、代理近似、信任域、超梯度、采样嵌套等经典求解方法。在NAS的具体应用上：1）将NAS形式化为min_A L_v(A, W*(A))，s.t. W*(A)=argmin_W L_t(A,W)的双层问题；2）将现有NAS方法分为采样类（网格/随机/贝叶斯TPE/进化/强化学习）与双层理论类（KKT重构/代理近似/超梯度/辅助规划）两大类；3）核心创新方法为辅助数学规划法（AP-NAS），通过对下层最优性条件∇_W L_t=0求关于A的微分得到Hessian关系式H_{21}dA + H_{22}dW = 0，并求解一个二阶锥规划（SOCP）或线性规划（LP）以得到在保持下层最优性前提下的最速下降方向（dA*, dW*）；4）使用L-BFGS和秩一两矩阵和等Hessian近似策略降低计算复杂度；5）将该框架衍生为LP-DARTS和SOCP-DARTS两个具体算法，并进一步扩展到超参数的"超局部搜索"以及GPT-2等大型模型的微调中。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10时间受限对比实验中，LP-DARTS取得92.56%的测试准确率（仅1.66M参数，19.91 CPU小时），SOCP-DARTS取得90.56%（2.23M参数），均显著优于原始DARTS的82.57%（3.38M参数），同时与P-DARTS、PC-DARTS、STO-DARTS等强基线相比也具备竞争力甚至更优。在ImageNet迁移性测试中，LP-DARTS和SOCP-DARTS分别取得42.50%和44.02%的Top-1准确率。在超参数优化层面，辅助规划驱动的"超局部搜索"在CIFAR-10上对Grid、Random、TPE、QMC四种采样器均带来稳定的精度提升（测试精度从~68%提升至~72%）。在GPT-2 Small微调WikiText-2任务中，该方法有效控制过拟合，使测试PPL在严重过拟合配置下从204.86降至153.03（25.30%改善）。整体上，双层理论方法在准确率和效率上均优于采样方法。
AI.conclusion: 双层优化为NAS提供了兼具理论严谨性与实证优越性的统一框架。基于辅助数学规划的AP-NAS（特别是LP-DARTS和SOCP-DARTS）通过系统整合二阶曲率信息并保证下层最优性，在保持低计算成本的同时实现更优的架构搜索性能，且该框架可推广至超参数调优和大型Transformer模型的正则化微调。未来研究方向包括：可扩展的结构化Hessian近似（块对角、阶梯型）、与其他可微NAS方法的混合优化、以及向更大搜索空间和应用领域的扩展。

title: How AI settled the complexity of the oldest SGD algorithm
summary: In 1937, Stefan Kaczmarz proposed a simple algorithm for solving systems of linear equations. This algorithm turned out to be the earliest known example of stochastic gradient descent, a ubiquitous computing paradigm that drives the training of modern AI models such as ChatGPT and Gemini. Now, those AI models have joined forces to discover the worst-case complexity of the Kaczmarz algorithm. This paper tells the story of how it happened.

AI.tldr: 本文通过 AI 协作（ChatGPT Pro 与 Gemini Deep Think）解决了 1937 年 Kaczmarz 提出的随机梯度下降（SGD）算法的最坏情形复杂度问题，证明了其最后迭代达到最优的 O(1/ε) 收敛速率，并给出了基于复分析的初等证明。
AI.motivation: Kaczmarz 算法（1937）是最早的 SGD 算法，但长期以来其最后迭代的复杂度分析是一个未解决的开放问题。此前 Strohmer-Vershynin（2009）的经典结果依赖条件数，Needell-Srebro-Ward（2014）给出的 O(1/ε) 速率仅限于迭代平均而非最后迭代。这一理论与实践之间的差距（last-iterate convergence gap）在数学与机器学习界长期悬而未决，被视为理解 SGD 动力学（包括 LLM 训练）最简单的模型问题。
AI.method: 采用"AI 主导研究"范式：作者将开放问题分别提交给 Gemini Deep Think 和 ChatGPT Pro；Gemini 识别出问题与算子代数中对称 Markov 半群（量子 Markov 半群）的联系，ChatGPT 基于此线索利用复分析方法（特别是 Cauchy 估计）给出了初等证明。核心技术包括：(1) 将 Kaczmarz 误差演化写为线性算子 Φ(X)=E[BXB] 的迭代；(2) 乘积表示 Φ^T(X)=E[W_T X W_T^⊤]；(3) 留一法（leave-one-out）恒等式将 Φ^T-Φ^{T+1} 表达为差分平均；(4) 利用复分析对正压缩矩阵 B 的插值函数 E_t(z)=B_t+z(I-B_t) 求导，并通过 Cauchy 估计界算子范数；(5) 通过 Loewner 序和非交换伸缩求和界二次项。
AI.result: 主要定理（定理 3.1）：对于任意随机正压缩矩阵 B 和 Φ(X)=E[BXB]，有 ‖Φ^T-Φ^{T+1}‖_{op→op} ≤ 3/(T+1)。由此推得：(1) 推论 3.2 解决了 Kaczmarz 算法的最后迭代收敛问题，证实了 Steinerberger 的猜想，匹配 Strohmer-Vershynin 速率；(2) 解决了 Attia 等人的均匀采样版本问题（界为 3n‖A‖²_op/T）；(3) 推论 3.3 解决了 Berthier-Bach-Gaillard 提出的无噪最小二乘回归中 SGD 最后迭代的长期开放问题，达到 O(1/T) 最优收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究以 AI 协作为亮点——Gemini 提供关键算子代数洞见，ChatGPT 基于此给出可验证的初等证明，展示了"AI 主导研究"作为自主研究与 AI 辅助研究之间的中间地带。但完全自主的 AI 求解均告失败，表明该问题处于当前公开 AI 模型自主研究能力的上限附近。结果在数学上具有真正的学术价值，显著改进并解决了多个顶级会议/期刊已发表论文中的开放问题，预示了 AI 在数学研究中日益重要的角色。

title: Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models
summary: We aim to discover diverse, generalizable perturbations of LLM internals that can surface hidden behavioral modes. Such perturbations could help reshape model behavior and systematically evaluate potential risks. We introduce Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE), an unsupervised method for discovering interpretable low-rank adapters (LoRAs) that can elicit these latent behaviors. CPE decomposes the computations of a deep transformer slice using a heuristic tensor-decomposition-based algorithm. CPE exhibits remarkable data efficiency, learning a large number of interpretable LoRAs from a single example. Even though CPE is unsupervised, we find that in some cases it can be competitive with supervised elicitation methods via brute-force enumerative search over weight space. For instance, CPE performs similarly to matched-wall-clock-time GRPO on the Countdown task for Qwen3-8B (85% vs 87%), demonstrating that CPE can efficiently elicit complex multi-token behaviors. Since CPE is unsupervised, it can also surface hidden failure modes, such as sandbagging, restoring 85% of locked BigCodeBench performance on a password-locked version of Llama3-70B introduced by Taylor et al. (2025). Additionally, since CPE explores behaviors in weight-space rather than token-space it can potentially ameliorate exploration hacking, a misalignment failure which may arise in sufficiently self-aware AI models (Ngo, 2022). In fact, we find that CPE virtually eliminates alignment-faking (Greenblatt et al., 2024) behavior in a Llama3-70B-based model organism developed by Hughes et al. (2025). Finally, we find that CPE can be used to initialize GPT-OSS-20B in an aligned basin when running GRPO on an environment prone to reward-hacking. By providing a data-efficient method to systematically explore the space of latent model behaviors, CPE yields a powerful tool for aligning AI systems and evaluating their safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果扰动引出（Causal Perturbative Elicitation, CPE），一种无监督方法，通过启发式张量分解算法在 transformer 中间层切片上学习可解释的秩-1 LoRA 适配器，以发现能引出潜在行为的因果重要权重扰动方向。该方法数据效率极高（仅需单个样本），可应用于行为重塑与模型安全审计。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 存在严重的模式坍缩（mode collapse），默认行为范围有限，掩盖了训练中可能习得的多样化能力。潜在行为模式既是未开发的能力，也可能是意外涌现的危险行为。随着模型可能发展出对梯度黑客（gradient hacking）和对齐伪装（alignment faking）等"粘性"抵抗能力，传统在输出层添加噪声的 RL 方法可能失效。此外，现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）面临"暗物质"问题，需要海量训练数据且可能遗漏大量特征。因此亟需一种数据高效、可在早期层发现可泛化扰动的方法，以重塑模型行为并系统化评估潜在风险。
AI.method: CPE 在 transformer 中间约 10–20 层切片中，将每个适配器参数化为作用在若干连续源层注意力输出投影上的单位范数秩-1 LoRA 集合，并度量其对固定目标层激活的因果影响 Δ^{S→t}。该因果映射由带指数激活的单隐藏层 MLP 近似，其训练目标（公式 5）同时最大化各因子的"因果重要性"⟨u_i, Δ^{S→t}(Rφ_i)⟩并惩罚因子间冗余。定理 3.1 证明该目标等价于最小化因果映射与其 MLP 近似之间高阶导数张量的加权 Frobenius 范数差，因此 CPE 本质上是在做 transformer 切片的启发式高阶张量分解。优化采用软正交化梯度迭代（SOGI）算法避免坍缩到少数主导方向。源层通常选在 n_layers/3 附近约 5–10 层，目标层在 n_layers/2 附近，R 固定为 1。引出阶段在无监督训练后，通过验证集上的标量指标 μ 选择最佳适配器并报告测试集分数。
AI.result: （1）行为多样性与可解释性：在 AI_CONVERSATION_STARTERS 上，CPE 仅用单个提示"Tell me a story"即训练出 512 个适配器，其一致性分布与在数十亿 token 上训练的 SAE 特征相当，远优于同范数随机 LoRA（DeepSeek-V4-Flash 评分下 AUC=0.98 验证）。（2）自然行为引出：在 Countdown、谄媚抵抗、越狱三类任务上，CPE 在所有模型-任务组合中均显著优于 SAE 特征与随机 LoRA；在 Qwen3-8B 的 Countdown 与 Sycophancy 上与 GRPO 统计无显著差异（85% vs 87%；96% vs 98%）；在对抗训练的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，越狱成功率 65%，为唯一非平凡成功的方法。（3）奖励黑客缓解：在 GPT-OSS-20B 的误规约奖励竞赛编程环境中，选择低黑客率适配器 88 初始化 GRPO 后，其轨迹与"金标准"奖励下的 GRPO 接近，显著优于随机初始化与高黑客率适配器初始化。（4）对齐伪装消除：基于 Llama-3.3-70B 的对齐伪装模型生物中，CPE 将 min(comply_free, comply_paid) 从 0.02 提升至 0.92，并可通过 max AF reasoning 指标将显式伪装推理从 0.84 提升至 0.90 或通过反转目标将其降至 0.00。（5）沙袋检测与修复：在密码锁定的 Llama-3.3-70B（Taylor et al., 2025）上，无密码访问的 CPE 适配器将 BigCodeBench 通过率从 0.43 恢复至 0.52（解锁基线 0.54），并在代码 diff 中精确定位被锁模型插入的手术式错误。
AI.conclusion: CPE 提供了一种数据高效（1–30 提示）、无监督的权重空间扰动发现框架，可引出多 token 复杂行为、揭示隐藏故障模式，并有望缓解未来自感知模型对基于 token 空间 RL 训练的探索黑客抵抗。作为对齐与安全评估工具，它在行为重塑、伪装检测与奖励黑客预防方面均展现出实用价值。未来工作可拓展至高秩扰动以支持更复杂的行为修改。

title: Does Role Specialization Matter for Explanation Faithfulness in Mixture-of-Experts?
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have recently been extended with role-based mechanisms for interpretability. This is typically done by assigning semantic roles to individual expert components, for example roles like synergy, redundancy, and uniqueness in multimodal settings. However, whether such structural role decomposition preserves explanation faithfulness of the overall architecture remains largely underexplored. We hypothesize that inter-expert representation overlap weakens effective role separation and degrades attribution-based faithfulness, even when semantic roles are explicitly defined. To address this limitation, we introduce representation-level decorrelation regularization to explicitly reduce inter-expert similarity in latent space. Using representation decorrelation objectives, we encourage clearer specialization among experts by minimizing representation overlap. Our experiments show that across multiple multimodal benchmarks, this separation consistently improves explanation faithfulness, as measured by comprehensiveness, sufficiency, and their Area Over the Perturbation Curve (AOPC) summaries, while preserving task performance. We further show that these improvements are not limited to role-based architectures such as Interpretable Multimodal Interaction-aware MoE (I2MoE). Similar trends are observed in a standard sparse MoE baseline, suggesting that representation-level separation may provide a more general mechanism for enhancing explanation faithfulness in MoE systems. Overall, our findings suggest that structural role decomposition alone may be insufficient to guarantee faithful explanations and that representation-level separation helps improve explanation faithfulness. To support reproducibility, the source code and supplementary material are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构中角色专业化（如 synergy、redundancy、uniqueness 等语义角色分配）是否真正提升解释忠实度。作者提出假设：专家间表征重叠会削弱角色分离效果，进而降低基于归因的解释忠实度。为此在 FL-I²MoE 骨干网络上引入三种表征级去相关正则化（Rep-Cos、Rep-CKA、Rep-Barlow），在保持架构、路由和归因流程不变的前提下减少专家间表征相似性。在 ENRICO、MIMIC-IV、MMIMDb 三个多模态基准上，去相关正则化在保持任务性能的同时一致性地提升了基于扰动的忠实度指标（comprehensiveness、sufficiency 及其 AOPC 摘要），且该结论可推广到不含显式语义角色的标准稀疏 MoE（GShardGate）上。
AI.motivation: 近年来多模态 MoE 架构（如 MMoE、I²MoE）通过为专家显式分配语义角色（独特性、冗余性、协同性）来增强结构可解释性。然而，这些架构依赖共享编码器并以同一任务目标优化各专家，路由机制虽决定激活哪些专家，却未强制分离专家表征空间，导致不同角色的专家在潜空间中占据高度重叠的区域。这使得角色分配流于形式、特征归因无法反映模型实际使用的证据——即结构化角色分解是否真正保证解释忠实度仍不清楚。本文正是从"专家间表征重叠"这一可控变量出发，系统研究其对解释忠实度的影响。
AI.method: 1) 骨干网络：采用特征级 FL-I²MoE，保留 I²MoE 的 M+2 个角色专家（每模态一个 uniqueness 专家、一个 synergy 专家、一个 redundancy 专家）和原始 PID 角色交互损失；2) 表征级去相关正则化：在不改变架构、路由和归因流程的前提下，针对各专家在原始输入上的 anchor latent 表征施加三种互补的正则化目标——Rep-Cos（最小化样本级余弦相似度平方）、Rep-CKA（最小化 batch 级线性 CKA）和 Rep-Barlow（最小化 batch 标准化后跨专家互相关矩阵的非对角元）；3) 总体训练目标 L = L_task + α·L_interaction + λ·L_decor；4) 评估协议：在 ENRICO（双模态 UI 分类）、MIMIC-IV（三模态临床二分类）、MMIMDb（双模态电影多标签分类）三个多模态基准上，使用 AttnRoll×Grad 等归因方法计算 top-K 特征遮蔽后的 comprehensiveness、sufficiency 及 AOPC；5) 辅助分析：表征几何分析（silhouette、CKA、相关性）、InterSHAP 合成基准上的角色对齐分析，以及在 GShardGate 稀疏 MoE 上的泛化实验。
AI.result: （1）任务性能保持：所有去相关变体在三个数据集上的 Micro-F1/Macro-F1/Accuracy 均维持在基线 2% 绝对差以内；（2）忠实度提升（Q2）：三种正则化方法在三个数据集上一致性增大了 comprehensiveness gap（identified − random）和 sufficiency gap（random − identified），例如 ENRICO 上 AOPC Comp gap 从 13.21 提升至 29.05（Rep-CKA），MMIMDb 上从 20.37 提升至 27.06（Rep-Cos）；（3）表征几何改善（Q3）：成对 CKA 与相关性下降、silhouette 分数在多数设置下提升，表明专家占据更分离的表示区域；合成数据上路由权重更集中于与真实交互类型对应的专家；（4）泛化（Q4）：在不含显式语义角色的 GShardGate 稀疏 MoE 上，Rep-CKA 同样提升了 ENRICO 的 AOPC Comp gap（20.24→28.97）和 Suff gap（19.71→27.01）；（5）消融：仅使用交互损失而无需去相关时忠实度不提升，仅使用 Rep-CKA 而无角色约束时仅有部分收益，二者结合时效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结构化角色分解本身不足以保证 MoE 模型的解释忠实度；当专家表征高度重叠时，角色分配可能仅是名义上的。表征级去相关是增强专家特化、提升基于扰动的解释忠实度的有效且通用机制，且其与基于 PID 的角色交互学习互补，二者结合效果最好。该原则不仅适用于 I²MoE 等角色化 MoE，也可推广至标准稀疏 MoE 架构，表明表征分离是提升 MoE 解释忠实度的更一般性手段。但作者也指出，最优去相关目标因数据集和忠实度指标而异，专家分离并非决定解释忠实度的唯一因素，其效果还受模态结构、交互复杂度和专家特化动态等因素影响。

title: Do We Still Need Fine Tuning? Turkish Sentiment Analysis in the Era of Large Language Model
comment: Accepted to the 34th IEEE Signal Processing and Communications Applications Conference
summary: This study examines whether supervised fine-tuning remains necessary for Turkish sentiment analysis in the era of large language models. We compare classical machine learning methods, fine-tuned pretrained language models, and prompted large language models on a Turkish e-commerce review dataset with negative, neutral, and positive labels. Fine-tuned BERTurk models perform best overall and outperform all prompted large language models in the full three-class task. The neutral class emerges as the main difficulty: while several large language models are much more competitive in binary positive--negative classification, they degrade substantially in the three-class setting by collapsing neutral reviews into polarized categories. The findings suggest that, in realistic Turkish sentiment classification, prompted large language models do not yet match supervised fine-tuning in the zero-shot setting, and that including the neutral class is crucial for robust evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对土耳其语电商评论的三类情感分类任务，系统比较了传统机器学习方法、微调预训练模型（BERTurk、ELECTRA）与提示型大语言模型（Gemma2/3、GPT-OSS、Llama 3.1、Magibu、Qwen3）。结果显示，零样本提示下的LLM仍无法替代监督微调，尤其在处理"中性"类别时LLM倾向于将其极化为正/负类，导致三类任务性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 随着指令遵循型大语言模型的兴起，一个核心问题是：监督微调是否仍是情感分类所必需？现有研究对LLM在细粒度、结构化情感任务上的表现结论不一，且对标注资源相对稀缺的土耳其语缺乏系统比较。此外，大多数评估使用二分类（正/负），忽略了"中性"这一真实场景中不可或缺的类别，可能高估模型能力。
AI.method: 1. 数据集：从土耳其电商网站爬取6,381条评论，经两位标注员标注为负/中/正三类，预处理后保留6,367条，按80/20划分训练/测试集（测试集1,274条）。2. 监督模型：BERTurk 32k、BERTurk 128k Cased、Turkish ELECTRA（学习率2e-5，epoch=5，batch=32）；传统模型（LR、SVM、RF、NB）使用TF-IDF（最大5,000特征）。3. LLM：6个模型（Gemma2:9B、Gemma3:27B、GPT-OSS:20B、Llama 3.1:8B、Magibu:11B、Qwen3:32B），统一提示词、temperature=0.1、top_p=1，零样本推理。4. 评估指标：准确率、加权精确率/召回率/F1，并通过混淆矩阵分析中性类表现及二分类重分析。
AI.result: 三类任务中，BERurk Cased 128k以0.837准确率/0.834加权F1最优，显著优于最强LLM Qwen3:32B（0.773，p=5.13e-5），相对错误减少约28%。中性类是主要难点（占测试集22.6%）：BERurk中性召回率0.608，而Qwen3:32B仅0.312、Llama 3.1:8B仅0.160；LLM倾向于将中性实例极化为正类（Llama 3.1:8B将70.1%中性映射为正）。排除中性类后进行二分类重分析时，LLM性能大幅提升（如Qwen3:32B升至0.908），与监督模型差距显著缩小，表明LLM擅长粗粒度极性判别但难以建模完整的三类决策结构。
AI.conclusion: 在土耳其语三类情感分类的现实设定中，监督微调（尤其是BERurk）仍优于零样本提示的LLM，LLM的竞争力主要体现在简化的二分类场景。中性类应被视为独立的决策边界而非正负之间的残差类别，三分类评估对真实场景下的模型能力诊断至关重要，仅依赖二分类会高估模型性能。

title: Two-Stage Prompt Optimization for Few-Shot Relation Extraction: From Reasoning-Guided Search to Gradient-Guided Refinement
summary: Automatic prompt optimization is still underexplored for episodic few-shot relation extraction with smaller language models. We propose a two-stage framework that combines reasoning-based prompt optimization with gradient-based prompt optimization. The first stage can use any reasoning-based optimizer to make broadprompt improvements in natural language. The second stage applies our GradPO, which uses loss and gradient signals to identify high-impact prompt spans and refine them with local edits. Experiments on FS-TACRED and FS-FewRel show that local refinement usually improves prompts found by the first stage, and GradPO is the most consistent refiner. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on FS-TACRED with Qwen3-4B and remains competitive on FS-FewRel.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段提示优化框架,将基于推理的全局搜索与基于梯度的局部精炼相结合,用于小模型上的情节式少样本关系抽取(FSRE)。其中第二阶段提出的 GradPO 通过损失和梯度信号识别高影响提示片段并进行局部编辑,在 FS-TACRED 和 FS-FewRel 上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 自动提示优化(APO)在关系抽取领域研究不足,尤其是使用小语言模型的剧情式少样本关系抽取任务。现有方法中,基于推理的优化擅长对提示进行全局语义改写,基于梯度的优化擅长对局部 token 进行精细编辑,但二者通常被孤立研究,二者的互补性未被充分探索。
AI.method: 两阶段框架:第一阶段使用任一基于推理的优化器(RPO、EvoPrompt-DE、ETGPO)对初始自然语言提示进行全局改写;第二阶段使用新提出的 GradPO,利用训练子集上的 token 级梯度,将相邻高梯度 token 合并为多个"高影响片段",通过 LLM 生成候选替换(GradPO-Gen)或基于目标模型 token 概率采样(GradPO-Prob),并借助束搜索在验证集上选取最低损失的候选片段替换,从而在保留提示整体结构的同时完成局部精炼。实验中与 LPO(无梯度)和 GreaTer(单 token 编辑)作为局部精炼基线对比。
AI.result: 在 FS-TACRED(Qwen3-4B)上取得 SOTA,F1 从 27.6 提升至 29.0(RPO+GradPO-Gen,5+1 迭代);在 FS-FewRel 上保持竞争力(37.5 F1 vs 此前最佳 38.4)。在 19 个可精炼提示中,GradPO 改善了 14 个,是所有局部精炼方法中最稳定且增益最大的;GradPO 主要在前几次迭代带来显著增益,几乎不改变提示长度;但在跨模型迁移时表现较弱(仅 3/8 改善),说明其编辑具有模型特异性。
AI.conclusion: 将全局推理式搜索与局部梯度引导式精炼相结合,是剧情式少样本关系抽取自动提示优化的有效方向。GradPO 作为可插拔的二阶段精炼器,能够稳定地提升不同一阶段优化器产生的提示质量,并在 FS-TACRED 上达到新的 SOTA;但其依赖模型特定梯度信号导致跨模型迁移能力有限,且仍存在超参数依赖与偶发局部不流畅等问题。

title: Fuzzing Large Language Models to Elicit Hidden Behaviours
summary: Sleeper agents are the canonical model organism of deception: models trained to behave normally but to emit an unsafe behaviour on a specific trigger. Eliciting that behaviour without knowing the trigger has not been studied systematically. We study fuzzing: injecting Gaussian noise into a model's weights or residual-stream activations and checking whether the perturbed outputs reveal the behaviour. On 6 backdoored models (7B-13B) we compare both forms of fuzzing head-to-head against temperature-sampling baselines. Fuzzing elicits the hidden behaviour more often than temperature sampling on 4 of 6 models (up to ~6x on OpenHermes-13B), and which form wins depends on the task, so both are worth running. Elicitation is uneven across each method's hyperparameter grid: a uniform sweep gives only a few percent on most models, while the best cell is 2-10x higher, so the bottleneck is hyperparameter selection, not the technique. To select hyperparameters without ground-truth access, we use a cheap proxy task (in-context secret elicitation, where a base64-encoded secret is placed in the system prompt for the model to hide) and run Thompson sampling on it to pick candidate cells, which we evaluate on the real backdoor. On the four models that can decode the secret, proxy-selected cells raise activation-fuzzing elicitation ~4x over the uniform-sweep mean (recovering ~70% of the best-cell rate on the best performing model) and weight-fuzzing by 1.3-1.8x. To our knowledge this is the first systematic study of fuzzing on sleeper-agent backdoors and the first to show proxy-task hyperparameter selection transferring to real-task elicitation. We also propose reporting such results as a (uniform-baseline, proxy-selected, oracle) triple, since these are three distinct claims that prior work has often blurred.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了通过模糊测试（fuzzing）——向LLM的权重或残差流激活注入高斯噪声——在不知道触发条件的情况下引出（elicit）潜行代理（sleeper agent）等后门模型中隐藏行为的方法。这是首个在潜行代理后门上对权重模糊测试与激活模糊测试进行头对头比较的研究，并首次证明基于代理任务的超参数选择可以迁移到真实任务上。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全研究中的潜行代理模型（即在特定触发条件下才表现出不安全行为的模型）在触发条件未知时难以被检测和引出。现有模糊测试文献存在两个空白：（1）权重模糊与激活模糊从未在相同模型集上进行过系统比较；（2）两类方法都存在超参数选择困境——网格扫描中只有少量"格子"有效，而实际审计者既无法承受全网格扫描的代价，也无法事先知道哪个格子有效。本文旨在填补这两个空白。
AI.method: 1. 构建6个7B-13B规模的带后门模型集（Llama-2 IHY潜行代理、OpenHermes-13B IHY、自训练Qwen-2.5-7B IHY，以及Qin等人2025的三个Llama-3触发重构模型）。2. 权重模糊：在每个线性投影上添加LoRA噪声适配器，扫描噪声尺度σ。3. 激活模糊：在残差流的某一层ℓ添加缩放高斯扰动，扫描层ℓ和相对幅度α。4. 评估100条WildChat提示上的引出率（行为正则匹配），比较4个参考点：未模糊基线、全网格均匀扫描均值、oracle最佳格、代理任务挑选的top-K。5. 代理任务：在系统提示中放置base64编码的秘密，用Thompson采样在该代理任务上搜索最佳超参数格子，再迁移到真实任务上验证。
AI.result: 1. 在6个模型中的4个上，模糊测试优于温度采样基线，OpenHermes-13B上提升最大（权重oracle达41%，温度t=1基线仅约2%）。2. 权重模糊与激活模糊的优劣具有任务依赖性，审计者应同时运行两者。3. Oracle最佳格比均匀扫描均值高2-10倍，表明瓶颈在于超参数选择而非技术本身。4. 在4个能解码base64的模型上，代理任务挑选的top-5格子使激活模糊引出率提升约4倍（达oracle的约70%），权重模糊提升1.3-1.8倍。5. Snowfruit模型几乎无法被引出，astrology模型温度基线已接近oracle天花板，两者限制了代理迁移的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统证明模糊测试可引出潜行代理后门中的隐藏行为，并首次展示了基于代理任务的超参数选择可迁移到真实任务上。论文提出应将模糊测试结果报告为（均匀基线、代理挑选、oracle）三元组，以区分"技术是否有效"、"选择器能否恢复信号"和"朴素部署能否找到信号"这三个独立主张。研究受限于小模型集（N=6，N=4 for proxy transfer）、手工设置的σ_max、未与MELBO/DCT等学习式引导方法比较，且未进行端到端审计实验，泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Hybrid Retriever Evolution for Multimodal Document Reasoning Agents
summary: Different retrievers, including lexical, semantic, and multimodal approaches, provide highly complementary strengths for multimodal document understanding, yet most systems combine them through fixed pipelines that cannot adapt to the demands of individual reasoning steps. In this work, we ask whether retrieval orchestration itself can be learned as part of the reasoning process. We introduce a failure-driven evolution framework in which a meta-agent autonomously discovers how a tool-using task agent should coordinate diverse retrievers during multi-step document question answering. The meta-agent analyzes incorrect reasoning trajectories, actively probes the same tool environment to diagnose root causes, and iteratively rewrites the task agent's instructions, turning retrieval from a fixed front-end stage into an adaptive, step-wise reasoning decision. The evolved agent learns when to invoke each retriever, how to combine them, and how to compose evidence across modalities and pages. On MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench, the evolved agent achieves gains of up to +19.6 points over the unevolved baseline and consistently outperforms recent systems including MACT, MDocAgent, and SimpleDoc. Detailed retrieval analyses confirm that these improvements arise from adaptive routing and evidence composition rather than reliance on any hard coded retrieval mode, and evolution dynamics reveal a progressive shift from narrow lexical behavior to rich multi-tool coordination. These findings establish autonomous multi-agent coordination as a promising paradigm for multimodal document reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种失败驱动的演化框架，通过元智能体(meta-agent)自主学习如何协调词汇型(BM25)、语义型(ColBERT)和多模态(ColPali)等多种检索器，使多模态文档问答中的检索从固定的前端预处理转变为自适应逐步推理决策。在MMLongBench-Doc和DocBench上，使用相同工具环境下演化后的智能体相比未演化基线提升最高达+19.6分。
AI.motivation: 多模态文档问答需要跨页面、跨模态的证据聚合。不同检索范式（词法、语义、多模态）各有互补优势，但现有系统通常通过固定流水线组合它们，无法根据推理步骤的需求动态调整——这限制了证据的有效获取与组合。核心问题不是哪个检索器全局最优，而是能否让自主系统在不同的推理步骤学会有意义地使用不同检索器。
AI.method: 方法采用双智能体架构：(1) 任务智能体(task agent)——使用固定工具集（BM25、ColBERT、ColPali、VLM检索、计算器），通过系统提示 P_sys 和工具解析器 P_tool 指导，迭代调用工具完成文档问答；(2) 元智能体(meta-agent)——离线运行，包含四阶段失败驱动演化循环：①失败发现（运行任务智能体直到产生错误轨迹）；②交互式探索（元智能体生成并执行Python代码直接探测同一工具环境以诊断根因）；③提示演化（基于诊断提出 P_sys 和 P_tool 的更新）；④经验选择（仅当候选提示在验证批次上严格优于当前提示时才接受）。算法运行N=20轮迭代，每轮 T_expl 次探索。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc和DocBench上：Gemini 3.1 Flash下分别从42.4%提升至62.0%（+19.6）和从73.4%提升至85.1%（+11.7）；GPT-5-mini下分别从40.7%提升至55.4%（+14.7）和从68.6%提升至79.3%（+10.7），一致优于MACT、MDocAgent、SimpleDoc等基线。消融实验表明移除真实标签监督、使用更弱元智能体或禁用交互式探索均会导致性能下降。检索质量分析显示ColPali为最强单一检索器（hit rate 86.1%），但oracle实验表明自适应路由与融合仍存在显著提升空间。演化动态分析显示智能体从早期BM25主导（迭代0的218次调用中占152次）逐步转向多工具平衡协调；救援率(rescue rate)分析揭示了检索器间非对称互补关系——ColPali可救援66%-80%的其他方法失败，但当ColPali本身失败时仅Agent-VLM能提供有意义的救援(37.8%)。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明多模态文档问答中的检索应当被视为自适应推理决策而非固定预处理步骤。通过失败驱动演化框架，元智能体能够自主发现何时调用每种检索器、如何组合它们以及如何跨模态和跨页面组织证据。改进源于更强的检索策略（adaptive routing与evidence composition），而非更强的单一检索器。这确立了自主多智能体协调作为多模态文档推理的有前途范式，对科学、法律和企业领域的长文档处理有应用价值，但需注意错误证据组合可能误导用户及过度依赖不透明系统的风险。

title: ARMOR: Adaptive Retriever Optimization for Low-Resource Telecom Question Answering
summary: Telecom question answering (QA) is a challenging setting for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): evidence is fragmented across standards, papers, encyclopedic resources, and web documents, and answers often hinge on technical tables, equations, and specialized protocol language. In low-resource subdomains, generator fine-tuning can over-specialize and degrade general capability, making query-side retriever adaptation an attractive alternative. To this end, we ask whether a fixed-generator, query-adapted RAG system can outperform generator-side adaptation, and which retriever objectives best support that setting. We motivate retrieval, rather than generator fine-tuning, as the adaptation target through a capacity comparison: under bounded-parameter and soft-retrieval assumptions, query-encoder tuning can have a smaller estimation term than supervised fine-tuning when its effective dimension is smaller. We identify two particularly relevant objectives -- the latent-document RAG likelihood, which optimizes generation utility, and the InfoNCE contrastive objective, which improves semantic retrieval geometry -- and leverage them jointly through a retriever optimization method targeting downstream QA performance in the telecom domain. Specifically, we introduce ARMOR, Adaptive Regularized Mixture Optimization for Retrievers, which learns separate temperatures for the RAG retrieval distribution and InfoNCE softmax and regularizes the adapted query encoder toward the frozen base query encoder. Across telecom-specific retrieval and generative QA benchmarks, we show that ARMOR improves evidence retrieval and answer generation in several in-domain settings. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文提出ARMOR（Adaptive Regularized Mixture Optimization for Retrievers），一种面向低资源电信领域问答的检索器端自适应优化方法。通过联合学习RAG似然与InfoNCE两个目标各自的可学习温度参数，并对查询编码器施加朝向冻结基编码器的余弦蒸馏正则化，在固定生成器与文档索引的前提下实现查询侧的适应性训练。在ISAC/JCC/SAGIN三个6G子领域上验证了检索与生成质量的同步提升。
AI.motivation: 电信领域问答面临证据分散（标准、论文、百科等多源异构）且依赖表格、公式与专业协议语言的挑战。在低资源子域中，生成器全参数或LoRA微调易出现过专门化与灾难性遗忘，且先验研究表明在基模型领域知识不完整时LoRA增益有限。基于Transformer的Rademacher复杂度对比（SFT vs RAG）在理论上表明：当有效维度满足 d_E·d_R·d_m' ≲ d_S·d_m 时，查询编码器微调的泛化上界可比生成器微调更紧。实证（图1）也显示查询侧优化在ISAC上带来的领域内增益显著超过基线生成器与生成器侧适应，从而确立了"固定生成器+查询侧自适应"的研究路线。
AI.method: ARMOR总目标包含三项：1) 带可学习检索温度τ_r的RAG似然损失——τ_r控制top-k文档软最大分布的锐度；2) 带可学习对比温度τ_c的InfoNCE对比损失——τ_c控制正负样本softmax的锐度。两个温度以 α = softplus(·)+τ_min 的形式参数化以避免退化。其梯度分析表明温度本质上是隐式自适应权重机制：1/τ因子决定各目标对查询编码器的梯度贡献强度。3) 查询蒸馏正则项 L_qdist = 1 - cos(q_η(x), q_0(x))，约束适配后的查询嵌入不偏离冻结基编码器空间。文档编码器与FAISS索引在训练全程保持冻结。骨干检索器采用intfloat/e5-large-v2，主生成器为Llama-3-8B-Instruct，并在1B/3B/8B及Qwen3-8B上进行规模敏感性分析。数据层面采用Tele-Eval源文档切分（10%源文档保留为测试集）以防止泄露。
AI.result: 在Tele-Eval开放问答上（Llama-3-8B-Instruct，top-16检索）：ISAC域ARMOR将答案得分从Base RAG的0.6893提升至0.7119，同时取得最佳R@3=0.7667与R@5=0.8200；SAGIN域得分0.7685（R@3=0.8400、R@5=0.8467）全面最佳；JCC域得分0.7719近似保持基线，但R@1/3/5均为所有微调方法最高。所有非ARMOR微调方法在至少一个域上低于Base RAG答案得分。组件消融（ISAC）：Base RAG=0.6893、Static Mix with Reg.=0.6729、Dynamic Mix without Reg.=0.6350、ARMOR=0.7119，证明自适应温度与查询蒸馏具有互补性且缺一不可——无正则的动态混合表现最差（验证了过锐化导致查询嵌入漂移的失效模式）。TeleQnA（多选，鲁棒性检验）：在三个域均未出现灾难性退化，与最优方法差距≤2个百分点。生成器规模分析显示ARMOR优势随模型容量增大而扩大：1B下与Base RAG基本持平，3B下略低，8B下领先2–3分，表明强生成器更能利用改善后的证据集合。训练动力学显示检索温度单调锐化而查询蒸馏损失在训练后期上升，反映领域专门化与兼容性约束的张力。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明在低资源电信RAG场景中，固定生成器、仅适配查询检索器是比生成器微调更有效且运维友好的替代方案。ARMOR通过可学习温度替代手工目标混合权重，并借助查询蒸馏防止查询嵌入偏离冻结文档空间，实现了RAG似然（效用驱动）与InfoNCE（几何驱动）两类互补信号的自适应平衡。结论主张低资源RAG适应应在兼容性约束下联合优化多个互补检索目标，而非单一目标或静态加权。理论方面，所提供的容量比较为"检索器微调在小样本下泛化更优"提供了基于Rademacher复杂度的解释性依据，但作者也将其定位为动机性论证而非终极判据。

title: SEVA: Self-Evolving Verification Agent with Process Reward for Fact Attribution
comment: Accepted at AI4GOOD@ICML 2026 and FAGEN@ICML 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Hallucination is the reliability bottleneck for LLM-based agents, and fact attribution verifiers are the last line of defense -- yet today's verifiers emit only opaque binary labels, leaving agents unable to self-correct and operators unable to audit. We present SEVA, a structured verification agent that emits evidence alignments, step-by-step reasoning chains, calibrated confidence, and a six-category error diagnosis with actionable fixes. Training such an agent with RL is non-trivial: standard binary reward on multi-component output triggers advantage collapse -- within-group reward variance vanishes and the GRPO gradient disappears. We resolve this with a process reward that decomposes verification quality into five independent components weighted 70/30 toward process signals, restoring the gradient and inducing an implicit curriculum -- the agent first masters verification behavior (alignment 0.917 -> 0.997, format 72% -> 100%), then outcomes (F1 64.9 -> 69.0). Structured output further enables a Verify -> Reflect -> Probe -> Refine self-evolution loop, which over four rounds on a 7B model surfaces an unexpected structural finding: each round produces a benchmark-specialist, not a generalist (+15 pp on HaluEval, -10 to -14 pp on TruthfulQA in the same model, persistent at 4x data). On ClearFacts, SEVA-3B matches GPT-4o-mini (69.0 vs. 69.8 F1) while producing substantially richer, auditable output -- confirming a principle that should generalize: for any RL task with multi-component generation, reward granularity must match output granularity.

AI.tldr: SEVA提出了一种结构化事实归属验证智能体，其输出包含证据对齐、推理链、校准置信度和六类错误诊断。该工作解决了GRPO在多组件输出上的"优势坍缩"问题（通过将二元奖励分解为70/30的五组件过程奖励），并发现自进化迭代产生的是"基准专家"而非通用模型。3B版本在ClearFacts上达到69.0 F1，与GPT-4o-mini（69.8 F1）相当，同时产生显著更丰富、可审计的结构化输出。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的可靠性瓶颈是幻觉问题，事实归属验证器是关键安全层。然而现有验证器（如MiniCheck、ClearCheck）仅输出不透明的二元标签，导致两个根本问题：(1) 智能体无法基于错误诊断进行自我修正；(2) 人类操作员无法审计验证决策。此外，将GRPO应用于结构化多组件输出时，二元奖励导致"优势坍缩"——组内奖励方差消失，策略梯度归零，使强化学习训练完全失效。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **结构化输出模式**：包含证据对齐A、推理链C、标签y、置信度γ、错误类型e和修复建议s六部分；(2) **过程奖励函数**：将验证质量分解为五个独立组件R_f（格式，w=0.10）、R_a（对齐，w=0.30）、R_c（推理链，w=0.30）、R_l（标签，w=0.15）、R_d（诊断，w=0.15），加非对称校准项R_cal，按70/30比例偏向过程信号，形成四层级奖励景观；(3) **Verify→Reflect→Probe→Refine自进化循环**：基于六类错误分类法（数值夸大、否定翻转、范围膨胀、时间偏移、实体替换、捏造）的弱点画像，按比例生成对抗性探测样本，迭代四轮。理论层面，通过命题1（二元奖励优势坍缩）和命题2（过程奖励方差下界）形式化该机制。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) ClearFacts基准上Seva-3B-GRPO达69.0 F1（+4.1 over SFT），与GPT-4o-mini（69.8 F1）相当；(2) 结构质量接近完美：对齐质量0.997、推理链0.995、格式合规率100%；(3) 消融实验证实二元奖励GRPO表现<65 F1，与SFT无差异，验证了过程奖励的必要性；(4) 训练动态显示隐式课程——行为（对齐/格式）在~150步饱和，结局（F1）持续提升至350步；(5) 自进化产生"专家"而非通用模型：HaluEval +15pp但TruthfulQA -10至-14pp，在4×数据规模下仍持续，表明效应由数据分布驱动而非过拟合；(6) 跨基准表现差异显著：平衡基准提升大（FEVER +8.6，TruthfulQA +10.6），HaluEval因负向预测偏差下降2.6。
AI.conclusion: 论文提炼了三条可迁移原则：(1) 奖励粒度必须匹配输出粒度——多组件生成任务需用过程奖励分解；(2) 结构化输出是双重用途资产，既可审计又可驱动诊断式训练；(3) 在单源探测分布下，迭代自我改进会向专业化漂移而非产生通用模型。主要局限：(i) 自进化回路缺少随机探测对照实验；(ii) 仅在3B上完成GRPO，7B仅使用LoRA未做完整微调+GRPO；(iii) R_d的非对称奖励面导致系统性负向预测偏差（35.9%假阳性率），需标签条件奖励归一化来缓解。整体而言，该工作证明结构化输出加过程奖励是使RL在多组件生成任务中可行的结构性方案。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search
summary: Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a central issue for these applications. In this paper, we focus on deep search scenarios, aiming to investigate the rot phenomenon and its mitigation strategies. By evaluating four flagship open-source models across three benchmarks, we reveal a prevalent but unnoticed rot phenomenon: extensive context causes models to directly give up or prematurely provide uncertain answers, and this issue is exacerbated as the context grows. Through pruning experiments, we demonstrate the relationship between the accumulated context and the rot phenomenon. Furthermore, we investigate mitigating this issue through context management and post-hoc rejection sampling. For context management, we systematically evaluate seven different methods across three categories, based on performance, cost, and impact on context rot, providing clear guidance for strategy selection and usage. For rejection sampling, we develop a rot-aware filtering strategy and demonstrate its effectiveness across three aggregation methods. Finally, we show that these two approaches can be combined for further performance improvements.

AI.tldr: 该论文聚焦于长程智能体搜索任务中"上下文腐化"(context rot)现象的诊断与缓解。研究发现，随着累积上下文的增长，大语言模型会出现直接放弃或过早给出不确定答案的行为；通过系统评估七种上下文管理方法与一种rot感知的拒绝采样策略，为实际部署提供了明确的策略选择指导。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于深度搜索等长程任务，模型在超长上下文中性能退化的"context rot"问题日益突出。已有研究多集中于单轮长输入(如图中海捞针测试)或人机多轮对话，缺乏对真实多轮、多源、逐步累积的智能体搜索场景中该现象的系统诊断与缓解方案的全面评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建四类终止状态分类法(give up/uncertain answer/confident answer/no answer)，使用GPT-OSS-120B作为评判器(与人类标注一致率达98.7%)。2) 评估4个开源旗舰模型(GLM-4.7/GLM-5.0/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B/MiniMax-2.5)在3个基准(BrowseComp/BrowseComp-Plus/xbench-DeepSearch)上的表现。3) 通过剪枝实验(丢弃工具响应/推理内容/全部累积上下文)分析rot与上下文的关系。4) 系统评估3大类7种上下文管理方法(压缩、修剪、隔离)。5) 开发rot感知的拒绝采样过滤策略。
AI.result: 1) 揭示了一种普遍但未受关注的rot现象：随着轨迹长度增加，模型准确率急剧下降，主要错误类型从"自信错误"转变为"不确定错误"和"放弃"。2) 剪枝分析表明rot不仅取决于轨迹长度或交互轮数，还取决于上下文内容；完全移除累积上下文几乎消除rot，但会大幅增加未完成轨迹。3) 上下文管理中，"keep-latest结合摘要"的混合策略在成本与rot缓解间达到最佳平衡；FoldAgent等上下文隔离方法性能高度依赖模型。4) Rot感知过滤在三种聚合方法(最少轮数/最短长度/多数投票)上平均提升2.6%-4.9%。5) 拒绝采样与上下文管理可结合以进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 长程智能体搜索任务中，上下文长度本身并非性能瓶颈，问题在于模型在长上下文中倾向于直接放弃或过早给出不确定答案。"Keep-latest+摘要"的混合上下文管理策略在成本与rot缓解间提供最佳平衡，配合rot感知的拒绝采样可进一步提升性能，为构建更稳健可靠的长程自主智能体提供了系统性的策略选择指南。

title: Redefining Maritime Anomaly Detection via Equation-Grounded Synthetic Anomalies
summary: Maritime anomaly detection is essential for ensuring maritime safety, security, and efficient traffic management at sea, with Automatic Identification System (AIS) data serving as a primary data source. Despite its importance, most publicly available AIS datasets lack predefined anomaly labels, forcing prior studies to rely on either distribution-based rarity or domain rule/expert-assisted labeling. These approaches, however, face fundamental limitations: statistical rarity often fails to reflect practically critical events, while expert-based labeling is costly, subjective, and difficult to scale. Moreover, both paradigms tend to overlook interaction-driven hazards such as near-miss approaches between vessels. To address these challenges, we propose an equation-grounded anomaly taxonomy that is implementable under a limited AIS observation schema and extensible to other AIS datasets. Specifically, the taxonomy defines three anomaly types: unexpected AIS activity (A1), route deviation (A2), and close approach (A3), covering both single-vessel and inter-vessel anomalies. Building on this taxonomy, we introduce a unified score-synthesize-label pipeline that produces LLM-guided plausibility scores, uses them to synthesize anomalies, and assigns timestamp-level labels. To rigorously assess detection performance, we further design benchmark evaluation settings that account for variations in temporal-window length and anomaly-type composition, and evaluate a broad range of time-series models and anomaly detection models. Together, these contributions provide a systematic basis for evaluating maritime anomaly detection methods across different anomaly types. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文针对海事异常检测中公开AIS数据缺乏异常标签的难题，提出了一种基于方程驱动的合成异常分类法与"评分-合成-标注"（score-synthesize-label）统一流水线。研究将海事异常分为三类（A1异常AIS活动、A2航线偏离、A3近距离接近），利用大语言模型（Qwen3-8B）作为受限评分器引导异常合成，并在OMTAD数据集上构建标准化基准，评估多种时序与异常检测模型，验证了基于领域知识的方程驱动方法优于基于统计稀疏性的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有公开AIS数据集普遍缺乏预定义的异常标签，迫使先前研究依赖两类方法：(1) 基于分布稀疏性的方法——统计稀有性无法反映实际关键事件（如近距会遇、异常机动）；(2) 基于领域规则/专家标注的方法——成本高、主观性强、难以扩展。此外，两类方法均忽视了船间交互驱动的危险事件（如两船近距离接近）。因此亟需一种既能锚定领域知识、又能大规模复现的异常定义与合成框架。
AI.method: 1. **方程驱动异常分类法**：定义三类异常——A1（单船：位置突变而运动学无对应变化）、A2（单船：COG/SOG短窗口突变）、A3（船间：基于COLREGs的CPA/DCPA概念的近距会遇）。2. **统一流水线**：分段AIS轨迹→LLM生成逐时刻语义合理性分数a_t∈[0,1]（仅用于选取注入时间戳与调制扰动强度）→方程驱动合成器确定性生成异常值与标签。3. **LLM受限使用**：Qwen3-8B仅作评分器，不直接生成轨迹；A3通过构造虚拟船舶轨迹实现。4. **基准评估**：在OMTAD数据集上构建T∈{12,24}、异常率{1%,3%,5%,10%}的多组设置，采用严格逐时刻AUROC/AUPRC/Best-F1评估。5. **基线**：覆盖传统方法（LOF/OCSVM/IForest）、专用时序异常检测模型（OmniAnomaly/USAD/Anomaly Transformer等）以及预测式模型（以逐时刻MSE作为异常分数）。
AI.result: 1. **专家评估**：A3操作性可信度100%，A2 83.3%，A1 76.7%；地理验证显示>98.6%的A3合成点位于海上。2. **稀疏性方法召回率低**：即使选取50%的稀疏异常，A1召回仅44.4%、A3仅65.2%，A2达99.85%——证明统计稀有性无法捕获位置尖峰与近距会遇。3. **A2最易检测**：VanillaTransformer (T=12) AUROC 94.39、Best F1 38.85，OmniAnomaly (T=24) AUROC 94.70。4. **A1最难**：最佳模型Informer (T=12) AUROC仅54.59，所有专用异常检测模型接近随机水平。5. **A3需船间建模**：单轨迹表示下性能介于A1与A2之间；引入成对表示（拼接/差分）后STGVAD Diff在多数配置下F1提升20-33个百分点。6. **核心发现**：检测性能主要取决于异常线索与模型归纳偏置的匹配度——位置型异常挑战重建式模型，运动学偏差有利于预测式模型，交互驱动异常需要显式成对推理。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一套基于方程驱动的海事异常分类法与"评分-合成-标注"流水线，将领域知识形式化为可操作的合成条件，弥补了统计稀疏性标注与专家标注的不足。LLM作为受限评分器提供上下文感知的注入位置与强度建议，确保合成异常的运动学一致性与操作性可信。该框架在OMTAD数据集上建立了标准化、可复现的评估基准，揭示了不同异常类型对模型架构的差异化要求，为未来面向船间交互感知的检测方法与更广泛的异常分类体系研究提供了基础。

title: PS-PPO: Prefix-Sampling PPO for Critic-Free RLHF
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) for Large Language Models increasingly relies on critic-free methods as a practical alternative to actor--critic training. Despite their simplicity, existing critic-free approaches propagate a trajectory-level learning signal uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. This requires full-trajectory policy updates for every rollout, leading to substantial optimization cost for long reasoning traces, even though intermediate prefixes often contain enough information to largely determine the final outcome. We propose Prefix-Sampling Proximal Policy Optimization (PS-PPO), a compute-efficient critic-free method for RLHF that exploits this temporal redundancy. PS-PPO introduces a prompt-conditioned cutoff distribution and samples a cutoff timestep for each trajectory. During the update pass, PS-PPO backpropagates only through the sampled prefix of each trajectory and applies an importance-weighting correction so that the resulting truncated gradient estimator remains unbiased with respect to the full-trajectory objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and RLHF benchmarks show that PS-PPO achieves large reductions in training compute and peak GPU memory, while maintaining accuracy comparable to strong critic-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PS-PPO（Prefix-Sampling PPO），一种用于无评论家 RLHF 的计算高效方法。核心思想是在每条轨迹上随机采样一个截断时刻 H，仅对前缀部分反向传播，并通过包含概率重要性加权修正使截断后的梯度估计器相对于全轨迹目标保持无偏。实验表明该方法在数学推理和 RLHF 任务上能大幅降低训练计算量和峰值 GPU 显存，同时保持与强基线相当的准确率。
AI.motivation: 无评论家 RLHF 方法（如 GRPO、RLOO）将轨迹级奖励信号均匀广播到所有 token，需要对完整生成序列做反向传播。对于长链式推理（reasoning traces），这导致高昂的优化成本。关键观察是：中间前缀通常已经包含足以决定最终结果的丰富信息（成功率在完成之前就趋于饱和），但固定截断会引入偏差，因此需要一种原则性的随机截断机制来利用这种时间冗余。
AI.method: 1) **无偏随机截断**：定义截断时刻 H 的生存函数 ξ_t = Pr(H ≥ t | x)，并构造重要性加权估计器 Ĝ(θ) = (1/K) Σ_k Σ_{t≤H^(k)} (1/ξ_t) g_t^(k)(θ)，证明其期望等于全序列更新 G(θ)。2) **预算化单调截断分布设计**：在期望前缀长度预算 B 的约束下，最小化截断诱导的梯度方差迹代理（对角近似），得到凸优化问题 min Σ w_t/ξ_t。3) **前向代理权重**：用输出头 score 范数 γ_t（可通过 h_t 和两个 log-sum-exp 归约项前向计算）替代完整 score 范数；并用基于成功/失败回放下一个 token 分布 L1 距离的奖励不确定性上界 u_t(x) 作为权重。4) **求解**：通过 PAV（Pooling Adjacent Violations）算法对拉格朗日无约束闭式解 ξ_t = B·√(γ̄_t·u_t)/Σ√(γ̄_j·u_j) 做单调化投影，得到最优单调分布。5) **训练时**：对每个 prompt 的 K 条完成独立采样截断 H^(k)，仅对 t ≤ H^(k) 的 token 反向传播，损失乘以 1/ξ_t 重新加权。
AI.result: 1) **数学推理（Qwen2.5-Math-7B, B=128）**：在 MATH500/AMC23/CollegeMath/MinervaMath/AIME24/AIME25 上 Pass@1 分别达 85.0/58.5/23.9/30.1/16.7/13.3，平均与 DAPO 相当或更优（如 AIME25 13.3 vs 10.0）。2) **效率**：每步训练时间 1.77s（vs S-GRPO 2.66s、DAPO 3.23s），减少 33%–45%；峰值 GPU 显存降低 15%–17%。3) **长度扩展性**：T_max=4096 时相对 S-GRPO 提速 2.8×，相对 DAPO 提速 3.3×，且准确率持平。4) **消融**：优化截断分布显著优于均匀/时间先验/启发式截断；预算 B=128 在效率-性能权衡上最优。5) **生成任务**：在 IMDB（Positive Generation）与 HH-RLHF（Helpful Assistant）连续奖励场景下，平均奖励达第二优，总训练时间和显存均大幅低于 S-GRPO 与 DAPO。
AI.conclusion: PS-PPO 通过提示条件下的随机前缀采样与包含概率修正，在期望意义上保持无评论家全序列广播更新的无偏性，同时将反向传播和显存开销集中于信息量更丰富的早期 token。理论上该截断估计器在一般终止奖励下都成立，实验证明其在大语言模型长链推理 RLHF 后训练中以显著更低的计算和显存成本获得与强基线相当的精度，为高效 LLM 对齐提供了一种可扩展的路径。

title: Towards Generalizable and Evidential Nuclear Magnetic Resonance-Based Molecular Structure Elucidation via Large Language Model Agent
summary: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is the gold standard for molecular structure elucidation, yet interpreting complex spectra for unknown molecules remains a bottleneck reliant on human expertise. While artificial intelligence has advanced this field, current methods face a critical trade-off: database retrieval cannot identify novel scaffolds, while de novo molecular structure elucidation models operate as black boxes, lacking the atom-level interpretability required for rigorous scientific validation. Here, we present NMRAgent, an evidential reasoning agent powered by large language models (LLMs) that bridges this gap by integrating specialized spectral analysis tools with chemical knowledge graphs. Unlike previous approaches, NMRAgent mimics the deductive reasoning of human experts: it takes experimental NMR spectra and molecular formula as input, plans the elucidation process, proposes candidate structures, verifies peak-atom consistency, and refines misaligned substructure through formula-aware fragment optimization. Enabled by its evidential reasoning, NMRAgent outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving top-1 accuracy by 46.5% and Tanimoto similarity by 0.502 on a scaffold-split benchmark with novel scaffolds in the test set. Besides, we demonstrate the agent's practical utility by elucidating the structures of two previously unknown natural products isolated from Hydrangea davidii and Vitex trifolia, and by correcting structural misassignments in established literature. By combining high-accuracy prediction with transparent and evidence-based reasoning, NMRAgent establishes a new paradigm for interpretable AI in analytical chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NMRAgent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于核磁共振（NMR）波谱的分子结构解析。该框架通过整合专用光谱分析工具与化学知识图谱，模拟人类专家的演绎推理过程，在scaffold-split基准上实现了46.5%的Top-1准确率提升和0.502的Tanimoto相似度提升，并成功应用于天然产物结构解析和文献错误修正。
AI.motivation: NMR是分子结构解析的"金标准"，但传统解析依赖人类专家经验。现有AI方法面临关键权衡：数据库检索方法无法识别新颖骨架（novel scaffolds），而从头生成（de novo）模型作为黑箱缺乏原子级可解释性，无法满足严格的科学验证需求。因此需要一种兼具高准确性与可解释性的自动化解析方法。
AI.method: NMRAgent采用三级层次化架构模拟人类专家的演绎推理：（1）知识层（Knowledge-Level）——LLM规划器通过化学知识图谱的RAG制定逐步解析计划；（2）分子层（Molecular-Level）——结合检索与从头生成工具构建候选池，利用UltraNMR密集嵌入进行重排序，并通过LLM驱动的Peak-Atom Verifier进行显式的峰-原子一致性验证；（3）片段层（Fragment-Level）——基于分子式约束和BRICS组装规则，对验证器标记的不匹配区域进行证据引导的片段优化重构。整体将NMR谱与分子式作为输入，输出可解释的候选结构。
AI.result: 在NMRGym scaffold-split基准上，NMRAgent达到Top-1准确率64.42%、Top-10准确率67.13%、Tanimoto相似度0.792，相比最强基线（NMRSolver+Formula的36.48%）绝对提升30.65个百分点，相对提升约84%。在nmrshiftdb和Exp450基准上分别达到81.05%和70.0%的Top-10准确率。消融实验表明检索、de novo生成和片段优化三个模块贡献互补增益。实际应用中成功解析了来自Hydrangea davidii和Vitex trifolia的两个新天然产物结构，并纠正了包括Altechromone A、Samoquasine A等文献中4个已发表结构的错误指认。
AI.conclusion: NMRAgent建立了基于证据的LLM智能体框架用于可解释的NMR结构解析，将传统黑箱预测转变为透明、基于证据的候选验证。其三级层次化设计（知识-分子-片段）结合化学知识图谱、谱图预测工具和峰-原子验证机制，为分析化学中可解释AI树立了新范式。局限性在于目前仅处理1D ¹H和¹³C谱、依赖数据库完整性、且LLM本身不内在理解NMR信息，未来需融合2D NMR等多模态谱图并通过智能体学习内化光谱知识。

title: What Drives the Inlier-Memorization Effect? A Theory of Outlier Detection via Early Training Dynamics
summary: Outlier detection (OD) aims to identify anomalous instances by learning the underlying structure of normal data (inliers), and is particularly challenging in fully unsupervised settings where no information about anomalies is available during training. Recent advances have leveraged the inlier-memorization (IM) effect, a phenomenon in which deep models memorize inlier patterns earlier than those of outliers, as a powerful signal for distinguishing outliers. However, despite its empirical success, the theoretical understanding of the IM effect remains limited. In this work, we present a theoretical study of the IM effect. Focusing on a simple autoencoder, we show that, under mild assumptions, the model can successfully memorize inliers while failing to memorize outliers during certain stages of early training. In particular, we characterize not only the emergence of the IM effect, but also its strength and persistence, and analyze how these properties depend on the data distribution and parameter initialization. In addition, building on these insights, we derive simple yet practical guidelines for enhancing the IM effect, including data preprocessing and parameter initialization schemes, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the ADBench datasets. Our findings provide a theoretical foundation for the IM effect and offer actionable directions for improving IM-based outlier detection methods.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论角度系统研究了无监督异常检测中的"内部记忆效应"(Inlier-Memorization, IM),针对简单自编码器在高斯初始化条件下通过梯度下降训练时的早期动力学行为进行了严格分析,证明了存在一个训练迭代区间[T₁, T₂]使得内部样本的重构误差严格小于良分离的外部样本,并据此提出了两条实用改进策略(紧凑表示 + EMA初始化),在ADBench 57个数据集上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: IM效应(即深度无监督模型在训练早期优先拟合内部样本而非外部样本)已成为无监督异常检测(UOD)的重要经验工具(代表作包括ODIM、ALTBI、IMBoost等),但其理论基础严重不足:缺乏对"效应持续多久"、"分离强度多大"、"受哪些因素影响"等关键问题的严格理论解释。这一理论空白既限制了IM效应的可解释性,也阻碍了基于IM的检测方法的原理性设计。
AI.method:
1. **问题建模**:采用单隐层无偏置自编码器 F_W(x) = A·φ(Wx),其中编码器权重W通过梯度下降训练,解码器A固定。采用聚类结构数据假设:x_i = μ_{g(i)} + ξ_i + o_i,其中ξ_i为类内扰动(‖ξ_i‖₂ ≤ ε_c),o_i为离群扰动。
2. **理论分析框架**:
• 引入"聚类一致子空间"S₊(同一聚类内样本输出相同的子空间)与正交补S₋;
• 证明S₋方向上的残差在梯度下降中不变,仅S₊方向残差以(1 - ηα²)^τ速率指数衰减;
• 建立"聚类中心动力学"与"实际动力学"之间的扰动界(Proposition A.8);
• 在精确聚类情形(ε_c=0)和一般情形(ε_c>0)下分别证明IM区间[T₁, T₂]的存在性(Corollary A.12)。
3. **IM区间刻画**:T₁ = c(n_min↓),T₂ = c(n_min↑, n_max↓, ε_c↓, R̃₀↓, ρ↓, δ↑),其中R̃₀衡量初始化对聚类结构的捕获质量。
4. **实用策略**:
• 数据预处理:使用预训练表示(TabPFN/ViT/BERT)降低ε_c;
• 权重初始化:在前50次迭代上施加EMA(decay=0.999)以获得小R̃₀。
AI.result:
1. **仿真验证**(可控设置,n=2000, K=3):
• ε_c由4.0降至1.0:峰值AUROC从0.944升至0.975,IM窗口从193扩至372 epochs;
• 簇大小比例从1:1变为27:1:IM窗口从596缩至462 epochs;
• 离群率ρ从0.03升至0.25:IM窗口从391缩至94 epochs;
• 初始化误差R̃₀从0.60降至0.40:IM窗口从362扩至472 epochs。
2. **ADBench基准**(57数据集):
• 改进的ALTBI(EMA + TabPFN):平均AUROC 0.766(原始0.757),平均AUPRC 0.352,均达SOTA;
• 改进的ODIM:平均AUROC 0.757(原始0.751);
• 在CIFAR10/FashionMNIST上ViT+EMA组合带来显著提升(如CIFAR10的ALTBI从0.576跃升至0.888);
• 消融实验证实EMA独立贡献约0.6-0.7个AUROC百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为IM效应提供了严格的理论基础,揭示了数据分布(ε_c、δ、n_min/n_max、ρ)与参数初始化(R̃₀)对效应"持续性"与"强度"的双重影响机制。其核心实践意义在于:通过紧凑表示(降低ε_c)与EMA预热初始化(降低R̃₀)这两条极简策略,即可系统性提升现有IM-based检测器的性能,标志着从"经验启发"到"理论指导"的方法论跨越。未来工作可向更深架构、联合训练编码器-解码器、以及VAE/扩散模型等更广生成模型扩展该分析框架。

title: Accelerating Q-learning through Efficient Value-Sharing across Actions
comment: ICML 2026 (Spotlight); Adaptive and Learning Agents workshop 2026 (Best paper runner-up)
summary: Action-values are foundational to many control algorithms such as Q-learning. Therefore learning action-values efficiently is central to reinforcement learning (RL). However, learning them can be slow, requiring many updates to move values from their initialization, typically near zero, to their true values, which may be far from zero. Moreover, action-value learning algorithms typically update each state-action pair independently, without learning shared value structure across actions within a state. In this paper, we address these inefficiencies by introducing the mean-expansion layer, which accelerates action-value learning by sharing values across actions within a state and by changing the problem from directly learning potentially large action-values to learning a lower-norm representation of them. In deep RL, this layer can be applied as a parameter-free addition to Q-network architectures without altering the underlying algorithm. Applied to deep Q-networks and implicit quantile networks, it improves aggregate performance across 57 Atari games while increasing action gaps and dramatically reducing value overestimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出均值扩展层（Mean-Expansion Layer, ME Layer），一种无需额外参数、无需修改底层算法即可加速Q-learning的即插即用模块。它通过隐式基线在状态内共享各动作的价值，将学习高范数动作值向量的难题转化为学习低范数残差向量的更简单问题。该层在57款Atari游戏上应用于DQN和IQN均带来显著性能提升、样本效率提高、价值过估计大幅减少以及动作间隙增大。
AI.motivation: Q-learning等动作值学习算法存在两大低效问题：(1) 真实动作值通常范数较大（因代表完整折扣回报），而参数通常初始化为零附近，需要大量更新才能逼近真实值；(2) 现有方法独立地更新每个状态-动作对，未利用同一状态内动作值之间的高度相关性（即共享基线结构）。作者认为通过在动作间共享一个状态相关的基线值，可将学习大范数个体值转化为学习较小残差，从而加速学习。
AI.method: 核心方法是均值扩展层（ME Layer），定义为可逆线性变换 M_k = I + (k/n)J，其中J是全1矩阵，k是均值缩放系数。该层接收残差向量z，输出q = M_k * z，相当于将z的均值分量放大(k+1)倍后与正交分量相加，从而隐式构建一个基线（无需显式参数）。在Q-network中，只需在原输出层前增加此层（即作为新的输出层），无需修改DQN算法本身。对于表格Q-learning，推导出隐式基线Q-learning（IBQ）的更新规则：被选动作残差增加α_t δ_t (1+k/n)，其余动作残差增加α_t δ_t (k/n)，实现TD误差在所有动作间的信用分配。默认取k=n（对应范数最小化基线b*=∑q_i/(n+1)），大动作空间可取k=1以保证数值稳定。
AI.result: 在5×5随机网格世界实验中，IBQ在不同k值下均比标准Q-learning更快完成任务。在57款Atari 2600游戏上（5个种子）：(1) IB-DQN(k=n)的聚合性能（IQM）显著优于DQN和Dueling DQN，仅用不到2000万步（总训练时间的40%）即达到DQN的最优分数；(2) IB-IQN(k=n)在IQN上同样带来加速和性能提升，用约2/3训练时间即达到IQN最优分数；(3) 在所有57个游戏中均降低了DQN的价值过估计，部分游戏过估计减少超过100%（转为低估）；(4) 在绝大多数游戏中提升了相对动作间隙；(5) 与RMSprop+Huber损失的DQN组合同样有效；(6) 敏感性分析表明k过大会因梯度沿全1方向缩放过大而导致性能下降，k=1或k=n为较佳选择。RDQ（带正则化的Dueling DQN）虽优于IB-DQN，但其需要额外参数流和修改损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 均值扩展层是一种简洁、参数免费的架构修改，通过隐式基线实现状态内动作间的高效价值共享，在不改变底层算法的前提下显著提升DQN和IQN在Atari上的样本效率与最终性能，并有效缓解价值过估计、增强动作间隙。理论分析表明该层可降低表示范数并实现跨动作信用分配。局限在于：(1) k过大时性能下降，大动作空间宜用k=1；(2) 概念上的全动作共享基线与实际基于样本的单动作更新之间存在差距；(3) 对收敛性、价值函数学习轨迹及连续动作空间的扩展仍为开放问题。该工作表明：价值共享并不一定需要显式分离共享与独立成分，状态相关基线可能是Dueling架构带来性能提升的关键要素。

title: How Far Can You Get Without a GPU? A Systematic Benchmark of Lightweight Hallucination Detection Across Question Answering, Dialogue, and Summarisation
summary: Hallucination detection has become a pressing requirement for trustworthy AI deployment at scale. The most accurate detection methods depend on GPU-intensive inference, proprietary API calls, or white-box access to the generating model. This puts them out of reach for resource-constrained researchers and practitioners. In this paper, we explore a practical alternative: how well can hallucination detection perform using only lightweight, CPU-feasible methods built on publicly available models? We systematically benchmark five such methods: ROUGE-L, semantic similarity, BERTScore, a Natural Language Inference (NLI) detector based on a FEVER-trained DeBERTa model, and a score-level ensemble of similarity and NLI. We evaluate them across all three tasks of the HaluEval benchmark: question answering (QA), dialogue, and summarisation. We calibrate each method on a held-out validation split and evaluate it on 2,000 test instances per task. We find that no single method dominates and performance is highly task-dependent.
